NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Meet Bobby, the gentle soul. He's a sweet and loving boy who has stolen the hearts of everyone he meets. He loves kids 5-10+ with his gentle demeanour, loves pats and also play. He has a knack for snuggling, making him the perfect companion for those cosy, cold days. He'll happily curl up beside you, providing warmth and affection whenever you need it. Bobby is almost fully housetrained, making him an easy-going addition to any home, including other pets. He plays with dogs big and small, loves walks, enjoying the sights and smells around him, but he's also equally happy at home as your one and only companion, where he loves to be around you or play in the backyard, throwing a tennis or soccer ball to him and even watching TV! If you’re looking for a loyal friend who thrives on companionship and affection, Bobby is your boy! *Come meet Bobby at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Bull
TEXT: Bull is a nice boy who loves, playing, loves affection, is good on the lead. He likes meeting new people and new critters on his walks and is very social and outgoing with great character. He has been getting experience coming inside. There something about Bull that you will love.

NAME: Matilda
TEXT: Matilda is a sweet well balanced girl that would suit the life of looking after the yard during the day and coming in to cuddle up to her family at night. She is getting good experience coming into the home at the moment and enjoys her time in the yard. She enjoys her walks and making friends with the school kids and other pets that are out and about.

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Harry is an affectionate gentlemen. He knows his name and will come upon being called. Harry enjoys a walk and likes to relax in the yard or around the house. He is doing well coming in the home and relaxing for long periods. He is often visited by native animals in the yard and has a neighbouring cat that swings by that he ignores.

NAME: Penny
TEXT: Meet Penny🎾🐾 Penny is a bright, bubbly greyhound with a zest for life and a serious love for fetch! Toss a ball and watch her light up with joy – she could play all day if you let her. Her playful spirit and happy nature make her an absolute delight to be around. Always cheerful and full of personality, Penny brings positive energy wherever she goes. She travels well in the car, making her a great companion for outings and adventures, and she’s perfectly content relaxing in her crate when it’s time to wind down. Penny is the perfect mix of fun and easy going. Whether she’s chasing a ball, enjoying a ride, or snoozing in her crate after a busy day, she does it all with a wagging tail and a happy heart.

NAME: Bobby
TEXT: Bobby is a charming well mannered boy. He has grown up in a semi-rural setting surrounded by native animals, farm animals and other greyhounds. He is happy sharing his space and is comfortable on his own. He is friendly and social with everybody he meets. He travels well on the road and is good on the lead.

NAME: Mikey
TEXT: Mikey is a handsome hound who is comfortable to be on his own looking after things while your at work. He is very social and has been exposed to a lot of the world that some dogs may not be use to like trains, cattle, native animals and he travels well on the road. He is happy to make new friends and get out and about and like most greyhounds is happy to relax. He has had some house experience and is wonderful company.

NAME: Tiny
TEXT: Tiny is a quiet little girl who is very sweet & often shy with new people. She becomes sweet and affectionate once you get to know her. A house or townhouse in the quiet neck of the woods, with a nurturing owner, would be the best fit for Tiny. She could also live in an apartment if it's spacious/quiet with safe zones to call her own - eg baby gates and secluded spaces. A quiet home where she can settle in and thrive would be perfect for Tiny, this means a home without children and pets/dogs. She can do stairs & enjoys sleeping in a crate, however not required. She has shown she can settle for longer periods here and would suit working up to full timers. It would be amazing to see someone nurture her confidence and guide her through the world. She becomes playful, loves chasing toys around, likes treats and food, and walks nicely on the lead. She's happy to take treats and likes learning and training. Tiny is a sweet little dog who will make an amazing pet once she has settled in. If you think Tiny sounds like the right girl for you then apply to meet her today.

NAME: Beast
TEXT: Meet Beast🐾 Despite his name, Beast is just a big goofball with an even bigger heart! This happy boy has perfected the art of smiling — seriously, one look at that grin and you’ll be smitten. Add in his constantly wagging tail, and you’ve got a living, breathing happiness machine! Beast is a true socialite who adores the company of his fellow greyhounds. Whether it’s a gentle play session or a backyard zoomie, he loves being part of the gang. Toys? Don’t even get him started! Beast is a toy enthusiast — squeaky, bouncy, or chewy, he’s not picky. Watching him toss his toys around is guaranteed entertainment. He also enjoys exploring a backyard, sniffing out all the best spots, and showing off his model-like strut (with a grin, of course). Beast is crate-savvy and perfectly happy to come and go as he pleases — he treats it like his personal den where he can relax after a busy day of smiling and tail-wagging. He’s engaging, affectionate, and loves to greet everyone he meets…no one escapes a “hello” from Beast! If you’re searching for a companion who brings sunshine, smiles, and maybe a few stolen socks into your life, Beast is your guy. With his charming personality and endless enthusiasm, this not-so-beastly boy is ready to fill your home (and your heart) with joy. 💚

NAME: Flash
TEXT: Meet Flash🐾 Flash is a handsome, larger-than-life greyhound with a personality to match his size! This gentle giant is all about the simple pleasures — tasty treats, comfy naps, and plenty of pats from his favourite humans. While he’s friendly with other greyhounds and enjoys their company, Flash would really shine as the only pet in his forever home, where he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. He’s a relaxed, easy-going boy who’s just as happy lounging around as he is joining you for a gentle walk. Food-motivated and eager to please, Flash is the perfect mix of affectionate and laid-back — a true heart-stealer waiting for his perfect match. If you’re looking for a loyal, chilled-out companion who’ll fill your home with love (and maybe claim the comfiest spot on the couch), Flash might just be the one for you!

NAME: Herb
TEXT: Herb is a friendly, people loving boy who adores making new friends—both human and canine! He gets along well with medium to large dogs and has the potential to thrive in a home with full-time workers, as long as he’s given a little time to settle into pet life. This relaxed guy loves snoozing on the couch and having a cozy crate to call his own. He’s calm and adaptable, showing potential to be apartment-friendly as well. With his gentle nature and easygoing personality, Herb is all set to grow into the perfect forever home. Give him a chance, and he’ll season your life with love and cuddles! Herb is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Sophia
TEXT: Meet Sophia – the Sweet & Sophisticated Greyhound! 🐾 Sophia is a gentle 6-year-old greyhound with a calm, easy-going nature. She’s been around kids (ages 5 & 6) who can walk and feed her, and she takes it all in stride! While she might be a little reserved at first, once she feels at home her playful, affectionate side shines through. Sophia gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes and is the perfect mix of grace and goofiness.

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: Ernie is a shy boy who has made a lot of progress at the adoption centre. He is looking for a special home who will nurture him and continue his confidence building. He requires a family willing to take things slow with him as we have here. He would thrive as a solo dog with a 1-2 adults at home, or a calm dog to keep him company. He could spend a few hours alone or longer, with a secure yard or courtyard. He is very sweet, cuddle and adorable once he trusts you (see photos of all his cuddly moments!). It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Boston
TEXT: Hey, I'm Boston, a handsome blue boy. I'm young, playful and a total fun loving guy! I am goofy, adore people and due to my adaptable and personable nature, I think I'd be a great addition to a family with children. A few things about me... I am good with other greyhounds and can live with one if you already have one! I am great in a crate and do well indoors showing off good basic toilet training, however would prefer a house with a yard to frolic. I am polite around smaller dogs and would do well with short introductions to small dogs but due to my excitement levels I think it's best I am matched with bigger breeds of dogs for now. I can also walk up and down stairs due to my confident personality, and of course I'll do anything for a treat! I even know some tricks... I knows “down”, my name, reward marker, and I'm actively working on leash manners. If you're looking for a dog to grow up along side your family, consider me, a fun dog to be around, I promise to shower you with love and affection. Meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Michelle
TEXT: Meet Michelle 🐾 Looking for a dog who's as friendly as she is fun? Michelle is your girl! This affectionate greyhound is a social butterfly who loves everyone she meets, from kids to dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it's a game of chase in the yard or a cozy cuddle on the couch, Michelle is always up for some quality time with her human and canine friends. Her playful spirit and gentle nature make her an ideal companion for families seeking a loving and active dog. Michelle's enthusiasm for life is contagious, and she's sure to bring joy and laughter to any home lucky enough to welcome her. If you're looking for a best friend who's ready to play, snuggle, and share endless love, Michelle is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Coco
TEXT: Coco would love to live in a chilled out house or apartment (with a lift - no stairs). She is a very cute little senior lady with an adorable greying face. She is super affectionate, totally fine to be left alone (with no accidents or distress) perfect for those working longer hours. She gets along with greyhounds and medium to large dogs. She loves a treat and will be a breeze to train! This sweet little senior lady can't wait to snooze on your couch and be treated like the princess she is. Meet Coco at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Rhys
TEXT: *I have just stepped paws into a foster care home - check in soon for updates!* Rhys is a super affectionate boy and a true “leaner,” always ready for cuddles. He loves to play and even knows how to fetch – a rare talent for a greyhound! Rhys enjoys his walks and is always excited to meet new people along the way. Rhys has also done well in alone time testing and would suit full time hours alone with or without a doggie pal. He gets along well with other medium to large dogs, so with a successful meet and greet, he could happily share his home with a canine companion. While he’s shown he can settle well indoors, Rhys would love a home with a yard where he can stretch his legs, play, and bask in the sunshine. A household with adults or older children would be the perfect match for this handsome, playful boy. If you’re after a fun-loving companion with plenty of affection to give, Rhys is ready to steal your heart!

NAME: Zeus
TEXT: *I have just stepped paws into a foster care home - check in soon for updates!* Introducing Zeus; the God of sky and thunder. Ok so he may not be the famous ancient God, but his boy certainly is a wonder of his own. Zeus is a sweet, outgoing and confident gentleman. He will play bow at you and loves a good zoomie! He has shown to cope well by himself making him ok for a full time working household with a townhouse yard or full backyard. He would love a life of daily walks, interactive games and a family who likes training as he has shown to love learning new things here, he can even do the staircase (a big deal for greyhounds!). Zeus would enjoy a home with another dog his size and older children. If you’re looking for a sweet, silly, and social companion, Zeus is ready to steal your heart (and maybe your couch!). Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Nancy
TEXT: Nancy is a sweet, loyal girl with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging. She loves walks, pats and snuggles – this smoochie sweetheart will happily soak up all the affection you can give! She loves being inside with her people and is happiest when she’s part of daily family life. Nancy would especially enjoy having the company of another friendly dog (medium-sized, male or female) to hang out and play with, particularly if her humans are out at work during the day. Nancy is friendly with other dogs and older kids, and she has also met cats – she shows curiosity and a playful interest, so slow, positive introductions would be best if joining a home with a feline friend. With her playful nature and happy-go-lucky personality, Nancy is always excited about life’s little adventures—whether that’s a stroll in the neighbourhood, a squeaky toy on the couch, or just being close to her people. If you’re looking for a loving, fun and cuddly companion, Nancy can’t wait to meet you & smooch her way into your heart! 💖🐾 Nancy’s Wishlist: A loving home where she is included as part of the family Indoor access and couch cuddles Another friendly dog for company (ideal for full-time workers) Fun walks and adventures A family who will love her as much as she’ll love them *Come meet Nancy at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Wren
TEXT: Wren is a gentle, sweet-natured girl who can be a bit shy at first, but once she's met you and let her come to you, her affectionate personality shines through. A few treats and a little chat go a long way with this lovely lady! She loves her morning zoomies and playtime with her retired greyhound friends, then settles in for some chill time with the family – including a small mixed-breed, a whippet, a Jack Russell, and three older greyhounds. She's well-behaved indoors and enjoys being part of the daily routine, including playing with a 2 year old girl. Wren walks beautifully on the lead and is calm and confident around town. She’s a happy, social girl who loves a gentle pat and attention. On the farm she does not worry about cows and horses nearby. Wren would make a wonderful companion in a variety of homes. She’d be happy as an only dog with someone who’s home often or works part-time from home. She’d also be delighted to share her home with a small, friendly dog, especially a whippet, and loves to lie on the lounge. If you're looking for a loyal, gentle, and loving new friend, Wren could be the perfect match for you! 💝

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Honey
TEXT: Meet Honey🍯 Her name says it all – Honey is pure sweetness, with a playful streak that’s impossible not to love! Honey is a beautiful greyhound with a personality as sweet as her name! She’s a friendly, easy going girl who gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes, making her a lovely companion for both people and pups alike. A quiet and gentle soul at heart, Honey takes everything in her stride. She’s well used to travelling in cars and trailers, settling in comfortably wherever she goes — the perfect passenger for any adventure. Out and about, Honey can be a little strong on the lead at first, especially when she’s excited to explore, but she soon settles into a nice, steady rhythm. Once she’s in her stride, she’s a joy to walk beside. Honey also has a fun, playful side — she loves splashing about in the water and enjoys playing with her toys when she’s feeling lively. Whether it’s a gentle paddle, a game of chase, or some quiet time relaxing after a walk, Honey takes it all in her happy, calm way. With her sweet nature, gentle confidence, and love for both play and peace, Honey would make a wonderful addition to just about any home.

NAME: Cynthia
TEXT: Meet Cynthia💖 Cynthia is a gorgeous girl with a wonderfully calm nature and a friendly, social personality. She’s one of those dogs who just loves to say hello — always greeting everyone with a gentle tail wag and a happy sparkle in her eye. This lovely lady travels beautifully on the road and settles comfortably in the car, making her a great companion for days out or road trips. She’s also very happy in her crate, where she loves to stretch out and enjoy some well-earned relaxation time — Cynthia certainly knows how to max relax! She’s friendly and social with dogs of all sizes, though she does best with a proper introduction when meeting smaller pups, just to make sure everyone feels comfortable. With her calm, easy going nature, she gets along beautifully with other dogs and enjoys their company. Cynthia would suit a home that appreciates her balanced temperament — calm and relaxed, yet always ready to share affection and companionship. Whether she’s quietly chilling after a walk, greeting new friends, or lounging in her crate, she brings a gentle warmth wherever she goes. If you’re looking for a relaxed, friendly, and travel-ready greyhound who’s as happy to hang out as she is to make new friends, Cynthia could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Rita
TEXT: Meet Rita💛 Rita is a lovely greyhound with a wonderfully relaxed outlook on life. She’s the kind of girl who takes everything in her stride — calm, content, and always happy to go with the flow. With her gentle nature and easy going temperament, Rita is a true pleasure to have around. She gets along beautifully with her fellow greyhounds and enjoys spending time with other medium and large dogs too. Whether she’s sharing a quiet snooze or having a gentle wander with her canine friends, Rita is friendly and well-mannered in every situation. Rita has that special “cruising through life” attitude — nothing seems to bother her, and she’s just as happy relaxing in the sunshine as she is joining in for a stroll or some family time. With her calm presence and kind heart, Rita would make a wonderful addition to almost any home. She’s the perfect companion for someone looking for a peaceful, loving dog who will fit effortlessly into daily life.

NAME: Gertie
TEXT: Meet Gertie💜 Gertie is a lovely, easy going girl with a wonderfully relaxed nature and a heart full of love. She takes everything in her stride and has quickly proven herself to be a calm, confident, and gentle companion. This chilled-out lady walks beautifully on the lead — no pulling, no fuss, just happy to stroll along by your side and enjoy the journey. She’s not easily phased by anything and handles new experiences with quiet confidence and grace. Gertie travels well in the car and settles quickly, making her an ideal companion for days out or family adventures. She also has a soft spot for her crate — it’s her cosy little haven where she loves to relax and unwind. She’s fantastic with other dogs of all shapes and sizes and enjoys friendly company, making her an excellent fit for a home with existing dogs. With her calm and patient temperament, Gertie would also suit a family with children, as she’s gentle, steady, and easy to handle. Gertie really is the full package — kind, composed, and effortlessly loving. Whether she’s joining you for a walk, snoozing contentedly at home, or greeting everyone with her gentle tail wags, she brings a sense of peace and joy wherever she goes.

NAME: Bali
TEXT: Meet Bali🌴 Bali is a gorgeous girl with a gentle, calm nature and the happiest of hearts. She’s one of those dogs who simply radiates joy — her tail is nearly always wagging, and she greets each day with a smile and a nuzzle. This affectionate girl absolutely loves cuddles and will happily lean in for as many pats and smooches as she can get. Bali is a real people-dog who adores being close to her humans, soaking up all the love and attention on offer. While she’s calm and easy going most of the time, Bali also has a playful side that shines when she’s feeling relaxed. She enjoys a good run around and a bit of playtime, then is more than happy to settle down for some quiet snuggles afterwards. Bali is great with other medium and large dogs and enjoys their company, though she hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs. She would thrive in a home where she can share her gentle, affectionate nature and continue to enjoy both companionship and play. With her loving personality, calm presence, and ever-wagging tail, Bali is an all-round happy girl who’s ready to bring warmth, fun, and plenty of cuddles to her forever home.

NAME: Olive
TEXT: 🫒 Meet Olive🫒 Olive is a sweet, sensitive gentleman with a gentle heart and a calm presence. He can be a little shy at first, but underneath that quiet exterior lies a playful and loving boy who’s just waiting for the right family to help him come out of his shell. Olive has shown himself to be wonderfully sociable with other dogs — he gets along beautifully with his greyhound companions and even his cattle dog friend. He hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs, so gentle introductions would be needed if his new home includes them. This lovely boy enjoys simple pleasures: playing with his toys, exploring at his own pace, and relaxing in the comfort of good company. Once he feels safe and settled, Olive’s playful and affectionate side really begins to shine, and he’s sure to reward his family with gentle loyalty and quiet joy. Olive would hugely benefit from a home with calm, kind children who can help build his confidence through play and companionship. Their energy and patience will help him feel secure and bring out his sweet, fun-loving personality. He’s also a great traveller — Olive is relaxed and content in the car, happy to settle down and enjoy the journey wherever it may lead. Olive would thrive in a loving home that can offer him reassurance, patience, and gentle encouragement as he continues to grow in confidence. With time and love, this shy boy will blossom into a wonderful, devoted companion.

NAME: Aria
TEXT: Meet Aria Aria is a beautiful lady with a bright, sweet personality and a lovely zest for life. True to her name, she brings a joyful tune to every day — confident, curious, and always ready to explore the world around her. This happy girl has a wonderful, sweet-natured temperament and enjoys spending time with both people and other dogs. She’s good with medium to large dogs and loves a bit of playtime with her canine pals. Aria hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, so careful introductions would be needed if her new home includes them. Aria enjoys her walks and absolutely loves to have a good sniff along the way, there’s so much to investigate, after all! She also likes a fun run around in a secure area where she can stretch her legs and show off her playful side. She’s a confident girl who can be a little strong on the lead at times, especially when she’s excited to go on an adventure, but with gentle guidance and consistency she’ll soon settle into a nice walking rhythm. Aria would thrive in a home that appreciates her outgoing and affectionate nature — one where she can enjoy both playtime and relaxation in equal measure. Whether she’s exploring new sights, racing around for a burst of fun, or relaxing at your side afterwards, Aria is always full of life and love. If you’re looking for a friendly, confident, and loving greyhound who’s ready to share her playful heart, Aria could be the perfect companion.

NAME: Rosie
TEXT: Meet Rosie🌹 Rosie is a beautiful, gentle girl with a calm and affectionate nature. She has that wonderful greyhound grace about her — peaceful, sweet, and always taking life at her own easy pace. Rosie’s gentle temperament makes her a real joy to be around, and she has quickly become a much-loved member of her foster home. Living with other greyhounds, Rosie has shown herself to be friendly and well-mannered. She enjoys the quiet companionship of her canine friends and fits seamlessly into a relaxed household routine. She hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs, so careful introductions would be needed if her new home includes them. Rosie is a lovely balance of sociable and independent. She enjoys being part of family life — whether that’s pottering around the house, joining in for some gentle fuss, or simply lying nearby while you go about your day. At the same time, she’s perfectly happy in her own company, often curling up for a nap in a sunny spot or settling quietly after a walk. Speaking of walks, Rosie travels beautifully in the car and is always content on journeys. She makes an excellent travel companion, calmly watching the world go by or snoozing along the way. Rosie would be happiest in a home where she can continue to enjoy a calm, loving environment — either with other greyhounds or as the centre of attention herself. She’s an easy going girl who will bring warmth, gentleness, and quiet companionship to her forever family. If you’re looking for a relaxed, affectionate friend to share peaceful days and cosy evenings with, Rosie could be the perfect match.

NAME: Violet
TEXT: Friendly, energetic and adorable girl Violet is a sweet and reserved girl to begin with but loves to play and bounce around once she gets to know you. Violet walks perfectly on the lead and is polite and friendly with other dogs her size. We think her confidence would grow if she had a doggie friend to spend her days with. A backyard or townhouse yard would be a perfect fit for Violet! Meet Violet by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Shirley
TEXT: Shirley is a sweet young girl ready to zoom into your life! Shirley would be a great fit for an active family with kids who can entertain her after school, or a young couple looking for a bubbly companion. Shirley could live with other dogs her size, and due to her young age would do best with ongoing training and exposure to the big wide world. She has a bright, bubbly personality and aims to please! She is playful, goofy and affectionate! Meet Shirley at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Angus
TEXT: Angus is friendly and playful, likes playing with toys and confident in new places. Angus is active, fun and would enjoy a active, structured life of daily walks and adventures. Someone confident with walking a strong dog is preferred as he can be excited to get gong. Angus would be a great candidate to share a home with another medium to large dog pal! Meet Angus by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Daisy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Daisy! I am a delightful girl, looking to be plucked and bunched in to a home I can call my very own. Daisy will blossom around other dogs as she has experience with English Staffies. I LOVE walks and promise to always greets you with a wiggly body. She would do best with older kids as she is bubbly, energetic and fun loving. If you don’t want to catch yourself saying “oopsie daisy” because you missed out on meeting this beautiful little lady, fill out an application to adopt Daisy today & mention her name in your application comments. Daisy can be picked from Western Sydney.

NAME: Vicki
TEXT: Hi, I'm Vicky. I'm a shy, brave girl with lots of capacity to be your best friend. I am soft, quiet and am looking for the final step into my forever home. I would love a quiet, nurturing home without children to support my growing confidence. I am a team favourite around the adoption centre due to my sweet personality. I am engaged, can do stairs, and would love an experienced owner who has a townhouse yard or fenced backyard, who's been around shy dogs and can help me bloom into a confident girl. I promise to show you my goofy, trusting side once I get to know you but it might take me some time to trust you. If you're looking for a cute girl to teach about the big wide world, consider applying to adopt me. Vicky is available to adopt at Western Sydney.

NAME: Everest
TEXT: *I'm in a foster care home with a male greyhound and a male jack russell - check in soon to see what I'm up to* With a salt and pepper face and a gentle demeanour, Everest is the kind of greyhound you will so easily fall in love with. Everest has all your quintessential greyhound quirks whether that's a moment of zoomies, a biiiiig lean on your leg for cuddles, and not forgetting the sweetest eyes which will melt your heart. Everest is an easy going old chap, with an adaptable, gentle and understanding nature. He just wants to curl up beside you and go out for a trot around the block when you're ready, waiting patiently by your side during the day. He is super sweet and calm. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: *I have been in a foster care home for 6 weeks - read the update below!* "Sully is going well and has settled in and shows signs of improvement almost everyday. He is very good with children and with all types of dogs. He loves a walk and is good on the lead. On the lead he is well behaved and does not respond when other dog are walking near him. If I stop and talk with another dog walker Sully is calm and relates appropriately with other dogs. Sully loves to drive in the car and enjoys the wind in his face as he keeps his head out of the window. He loves a cuddle and pat in the morning and anytime during the day if he is awake." ------------ Hi, I'm Sully, a gentle, quiet natured blue boy looking for my new home. I require a home who respects my boundaries when I am resting and asleep. I get along great with other dogs and don’t mind spending time in the yard while you’re out – but I do love having the freedom to go in and out as I please. I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and take in the fresh air throughout the day. It would be great for my wellbeing if I sleep outside. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. When I first started going on walks, I wasn’t sure what to do, but with some patience and encouragement, I’ve learned to keep going and haven’t had any issues in a long time! Now, I just take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in, but I thrive best in a home where I still get plenty of interaction throughout the day. I love being around my people and enjoy a good balance of companionship and independence. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Daphne
TEXT: Meet Daphne 🐾 Daphne is a wonderful girl who loves to go wherever the road takes her. She travels like a pro in the car, calm and content, making every journey an adventure to look forward to. Whether it’s a quick trip or a longer drive, Daphne’s happy to be by your side, soaking up all the sights and sounds. This lovely girl is super affectionate and loves nothing more than curling up close for some quality cuddle time. She’s a real people person—friendly, gentle, and always ready to share her warmth with everyone she meets. Daphne is also a star on the lead! She walks beautifully, gracefully, and calmly by your side, making every stroll a pleasure. She gets along wonderfully with other dogs, big or small, and she’s great with children too, making her a perfect fit for a family looking for a loving and well-mannered companion. If you’re searching for a sweet, friendly, and affectionate dog who’s as happy at home as she is out exploring, Daphne might just be your perfect match!

NAME: Sonic
TEXT: Ready to meet Sonic—the greyhound who’s not just fast but also the speediest chill master you’ll ever know? If there were an Olympic event for maximum chill, Sonic would take home the gold every time. This laid-back gentleman has mastered the art of relaxation and cruises through life like he’s on a permanent Sunday afternoon. Whether it’s sprawling out on the couch or making himself comfy in a new spot, Sonic just gets how to settle in and make any place feel like home. Sonic is the kind of dog who never rushes, never worries, and never gets ruffled. He’s the perfect blend of calm and friendly—always happy to say hello to new dog friends, no matter their size. Tiny pups? Big fluffy dogs? Sonic’s got the patience and easy-going charm to get along with them all. And families, listen up—Sonic would be a dream companion for kids! He’s gentle, tolerant, and totally cool with the hustle and bustle that comes with a lively household. Whether it’s playtime or downtime, he’s happy to join in or just hang out, soaking up the love and good vibes. If you want a mellow, sweet, and endlessly loving buddy who makes life feel a little more relaxed and a lot more fun, Sonic’s your guy. Ready to invite this cruising king of calm into your home? He’s already made himself comfy in our hearts and can’t wait to do the same with you!

NAME: Ginger
TEXT: Ginger has lived around young children and small dogs in a suburban backyard for quite a while. She would slot into to her new home very well given her excellent pet prep and due to that she has been treated like a family member her whole life. She is stunning and has a wonderful personality, playful and affectionate describe her best.

NAME: Bluey
TEXT: Bluey is a wonderful girl, she likes to run and play and she likes to relax. She is very social and friendly with all size dogs and has been living in a suburban area all her life with young kids and small dogs. Her personality is stunning along with her looks. She just wants to be your mate.

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection. Although Solly hasn’t had much experience around small dogs or cats, he didn’t seem phased by our meta cat during his visit, which is a promising sign. With a slow and careful introduction, he could comfortably live with smaller pets. His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Kai
TEXT: Kai is a social and confident boy, who is polite with greyhounds and very friendly with everyone he meets! He is gentle on the lead, showing off his lovely manners. He comes when called and aims to please! He likes carrying around toys, and would enjoy a backyard to frolic in during the day. Shorter hours alone are best for Kai as he learns to settle into pet life. Meet Kai at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Rousey
TEXT: Rousey is a sweet gentle girl, a bit shy and reserved at first but already warming up with us at the centre! She loves food and will happily take a treat from you. She is gentle on the lead and promises to walk nicely on the lead for you on adventures. She LOVES chin scratches, too! This lovely girl would suit a home with respectful children, and wouldn't mind sharing her home with another dog her size! Rousey is available by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Ruby
TEXT: Ruby has been learning about pet life while she awaits her forever home. She loves toys, and loves carrying them around! She is friendly and polite with people as well as dogs her size. This lovely girl has been around older kids and would suit a house with a yard she can frolic around. She is sweet, confident and comes when called. This gorgeous little lady can't wait to be a loved family member included in daily activities whether that's picking up the kids from school or heading out to sporting games on the weekend. Meet Ruby by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Choppy
TEXT: Choppy is an excitable boy, who has been friendly with kids 2 YO and up. He's interested in the snacks in your pocket, and any attention you're happy to give him! He's social, loves food and walks lovely on the lead too. He has shown to be OK in a crate too. A house with a yard and an active structured life would be the best fit for Choppy. He's friendly and seeks attention, so shorter hours alone while he first settles in would suit best. Choppy is available by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Judd
TEXT: Judd is a handsome, sweet guy, who is gentle and who warms up quickly to praise and gentle companionship. We think a home with older/teen kids would benefit Judd. A house with a yard or townhouse would be best! He likes toys and is known to carry them around with him proudly - so cute! He doesn't mind sharing the love and could live with another Medium to Large dog pal, too! Meet Judd at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Abby
TEXT: Meet Abby! Abby is a sleek, 4-year-old black greyhound with a heart full of joy and a tail that never stops wagging. Her sweet and bubbly personality lights up every room she enters, and her playful energy is contagious. Whether she’s trotting around the yard or greeting you with a happy bounce, Abby brings fun and affection to every moment. She’s incredibly friendly and loves being around people, always ready to share her love and enthusiasm. She loves a zoomie or two!! Abby does have pannus, a manageable eye condition, and she’s wonderfully cooperative with her daily eye drops. With a little ongoing support, she continues to thrive and enjoy life to the fullest. Abby is the kind of dog who reminds you to smile, live in the moment, and appreciate the simple joys of companionship.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Missy – The Gentle Soul Missy is a beautiful 10-year-old black greyhound whose calm presence and kind heart make her the perfect companion. With her soft eyes and graceful demeanor, she exudes warmth and serenity. Missy is gentle with everyone she meets and her sweet nature makes her a comforting couch buddy. Though she’s in her golden years, Missy still enjoys quiet strolls and cozy naps in sunny spots. She’s the kind of dog who will rest her head on your lap and make you feel like everything is right in the world. Her loyalty is unwavering, and her affection is given freely to those lucky enough to know her. Missy is more than just a pet—she’s a gentle friend, a quiet listener, and a loving presence in any home. Missy has already lived as a pet in a home and is fully toilet trained.

NAME: Zena
TEXT: Hello, I'm Zena! Zena is a happy, friendly girl, who would suit a nurturing, calm household to really thrive into the cheeky, confident girl we've seen here at the adoption centre! A home without kids would support her confidence the best. She can live with another calm dog her size but this isn't a necessity, as she really enjoys the company of her humans! Zena does best indoors in a quiet room - a house with a backyard is best suited, so Zena can have space to play and relax. This gorgeous girl has shown us her confident side by conquering our stair case all by herself! Zena's favourite activity is settling down in a cozy area while enjoying a Kong or a food puzzle, since treats are her second favourite thing! She is phenomenal with her training cues - (I know my name, how to go "down" and settle on my bed and am currently learning how to "sit"!) Zena is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Wichita
TEXT: Say hello to the bouncy and hilarious Wichita! This gorgeous brindle girl is full of fun and love and we just know she is going to make a fantastic pet! Wichita is a friendly and affectionate girl, known to approach everyone she comes across on walks and politely hustle treats out of anyone she can. She has a playful and fun-loving personality and loves to carry her toys around and play goofy games of fetch in her yard. She would love a little yard to call her own and would thrive best in a quieter neighbourhood without too much hustle and bustle going on beyond the fence. Wichita is friendly and social with other dogs around her size, and would be suitable to live with a medium-large canine companion. In fact, we have noticed Wichita feels calmer and more confident when she has a dog buddy to hang with. Older kids would love her playful side and are suitable provided they are also happy to respect her space when she needs a break. The snuggly and playful Wichita can't wait to start her new life with you! Apply online to foster or adopt this adorable girl.

NAME: Minnie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Little miss Minnie is a sweet and gentle girl who enjoys a slow, short stroll and relaxing on her bed, or even better, the the couch! This little lady walks beautifully on the lead and knows beds are made for laying down and relaxing! She is super social and enjoys a good ear scratch! Minnie is very comfortable around other greyhounds, so a home with a fellow greyhound could support her confidence and social learning whilst settling into a new environment, however, this isn't a necessity, as she loves people and with a little time, guidance and patience, Minnie will thrive in a calm and supportive home. She has shown to settle best in indoor spaces, so indoor/outdoor access would be best. Minnie has a high food drive and is very switched on, showing you can teach an old pup new tricks! She enjoys her snuffle mat and her food puzzles the most! Minnie's training sessions are full of fun and laughs, as her personality absolutely shines once she feels secure. She responds to her name, has learnt "on your bed" and has mastered the stairs, however, due to her age, a home with few stairs would be best. Minnie is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Harry
TEXT: Say hello to Harry! A sweet, social boy who’s ready to find his forever home. Harry absolutely adores all the humans he meets whilst out on his daily walks or during day to day interactions. This guy is sure to bring lots of love and fun into your home, bringing along his youthful personality and his love of affection and play. Harry loves interacting with his Greyhound mates, so pending a meet and greet, may suit a home with another medium to large breed. Harry would love a home with a backyard although has the potential to settle in a smaller home like an apartment or townhouse, perhaps with the company of another dog. If you're looking for a best mate or a new addition to your family, meet Harry at Western Sydney!

NAME: Ryan
TEXT: Ryan has spent time in a foster home — keep reading to find out why his foster carer loved him so much! "Ryan is a sweet, gentle soul with the calmest nature you’ll ever meet. He loves lounging near you quietly, always happy to just be in your presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, gets along well with people, and has such expressive eyes that tell you exactly how he’s feeling. He’s low-maintenance, clean, and well-behaved around the house. He enjoys short walks and long naps, and has a soft spot for comfy bedding and gentle pats. While I’ve come to care for him deeply, I’ve realised I’m not quite ready for a dog at this stage. Ryan deserves a home where he can be someone’s forever companion. He’ll make an incredible addition to any calm, loving household." Ryan would suit a full-time working family, with a backyard. He is outgoing and friendly with people, loves treats and would also suit a home with another medium-large canine companion. Ryan loves his walks around the adoption centre (pictured!) — and did we mention he’s super smart? 🐾 He already knows “on your bed,” “down,” and “shake,” among plenty of other tricks he’s learned in pet training. Ryan’s waiting for his new best friends to pick him up at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre — could that be you?

NAME: Molly (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hey, I'm Molly! I'm an affectionate, playful and fun loving girl! I'm a sweet young girl who would do best with an active loving home, I can live in a house with a backyard, or apartment with a structured family life. I have come out of my shell at the centre with the power of toys! I love having fun and getting treats for being on my best behaviour all the time. I am great with other greyhounds and can live with another big dog, and have even enjoyed play (chase and be chased) moments with the greyhounds here. I can walk up and down stairs, too! With a structure I could do longer hours left alone, and have done well for short stints in a crate. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a playful, sweet-natured boy with a cheeky streak and a big heart. He’s lived with a young cattle dog puppy and showed plenty of patience, and he currently shares his life with a couple of toddlers who climb all over him—he doesn’t mind a bit! Jack LOVES his toys (especially fetch!) and is super treat-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze. He’s all about having a good play, then flopping onto a comfy bed for a well-earned nap. Jack’s also been known to “reorganise” shoes around the house—just his way of helping with interior design! If you’re after a fun-loving, kid-friendly companion with a mischievous grin and a heart of gold, Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Burt
TEXT: Burt is a total character who thrives on human attention and isn’t shy about making sure you notice him! He can pull like a pro at first on walks, but give him a little time and he settles right down. Burt gets along with other greyhounds at home but prefers to be the king of his castle—he’s got a strong “mine” vibe when it comes to his food and toys. He’s great with kids of all ages and has plenty of experience being a patient, lovable buddy. Burt’s looking for someone who’s home most of the time to keep him company and soak up all his charm. Cats aren’t really his cup of tea, so a feline-free home would suit him best. Ready for a lively, loyal companion? Burt’s your guy!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a calm and quiet lady who walks well on lead and prefers a relaxed lifestyle—perfect for someone looking for a low-key companion. She enjoys a little play with toys now and then, plus the occasional zoomie to remind you she’s still got some pep in her step. Bertha is best suited as a solo dog and would be a wonderful match for someone who wants a peaceful friend to share their days with—especially if you work from home and can keep her company. While she’s not a fan of cats, Bertha’s easy-going nature makes her a sweet and steady companion for the right home.

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Bonnie is a sweet and social girl who walks well on lead and absolutely loves playing with toys—whether she’s teaming up with a human for some playtime or putting on a one-dog toy show all by herself. She’s great at keeping busy and thrives on affection, always ready to share cuddles and generous face licks. Bonnie is very friendly with the greyhounds she lives with and gets along wonderfully with them. While she hasn’t been around cats before, she may do well with a slow introduction to smaller dogs. If you’re looking for a playful, loving companion who’s equal parts fun and snuggles, Bonnie could be the perfect fit!

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a confident, energetic guy who walks beautifully on lead and loves to bound around with enthusiasm. He’s super engaging with people and thrives on treats—perfect for training and bonding! While Jimmy enjoys playing with other greyhounds during his outings, he prefers to be the only dog in the home to keep things calm and comfortable. Jimmy hasn’t had much experience with cats and tends to prefer a pet-free feline zone, so a cat-free home would be best. Jimmy would shine in an active household where he can join in on plenty of adventures and daily fun. If you’re looking for a lively, loyal, Jimmy is your guy!

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Missy is a laid-back greyhound who’s all about the simple pleasures in life—lounging in a cozy spot and soaking up the calm. She’s not one for marathons (unless it’s a Netflix one) and is more than happy with a daily stroll and a quick burst of zoomies to stretch her legs. Missy gets along well with other large dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and has been cat-tested with our resident feline without much fuss. While she hasn’t lived with cats before, a slow and thoughtful introduction will be key. If you're looking for a sweet, easy-going companion, Missy might just be your perfect match!

NAME: Goose
TEXT: Meet Goose – the big-hearted goofball! 🐾 Goose is a gentle boy who loves being part of whatever you’re doing—whether it’s pottering in the garden, hanging out in the shed, or going for a drive (he’s a great traveller!). He’s recently discovered the joys of indoor life—lounging on the couch or his bed with legs in the air is a favourite pastime! Goose is house-trained, sun-bakes like a pro ☀️, and also enjoys a comfy spot on the verandah or patio. Friendly with everyone he meets, Goose loves toys (especially his beloved soccer ball!), swims, and easy, sniffy walks. He’s met kids 10+ and is calm around other dogs🐶. Goose is easy-going, friendly and happy who would love a home where someone is around more often than not, easily suited to retirees to travel with or someone wanting a companion dog He’s quiet, only giving the occasional bark for more pats or when dinner’s on the way. Apart from missing two toes from an old puppy injury he still likes a walk, preferably on grass, and is a healthy, affectionate boy ready to share his big heart with you. 💙

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddy! Freddy is a bundle of joy and energy, always ready for a game of fetch or to chase his favourite squeaky toys around the house. This playful pup has a heart full of love and a tail that’s practically a built-in happiness meter—it’s almost always wagging! Freddy would thrive in a semi-active home where there’s plenty of time for fun play sessions balanced with relaxing downtime. He walks beautifully on the lead, making every stroll a breeze for both him and his humans. Whether you’re heading out for a casual wander or a playful fetch session in the park, Freddy’s enthusiasm is infectious. This friendly boy gets along wonderfully with other dogs and cats, making him a fantastic addition to a multi-pet household. His easy-going nature means he’s happy to make new furry friends and fit right into your family. If you’re looking for a cheerful, loving companion who’s as playful as he is well-mannered, Freddy is ready to bring smiles, wagging tails, and plenty of squeaky toy fun into your life. Why Freddy’s a perfect match: 🎾 Loves playing fetch and squeaky toys 🎾 Tail always wagging with happiness 🎾 Walks well on the lead 🎾 Perfect for a semi-active lifestyle 🎾 Great with dogs and cats alike Ready to add some playful puppy magic to your home? Freddy can’t wait to meet you!

NAME: Tim
TEXT: Meet Tim!! If you’re ready for a whirlwind of fun and a whole lot of love, Tim is your guy! This energetic greyhound absolutely loves to bound around and do zoomies that could make anyone smile. Whether it’s a quick sprint around the yard or a joyful burst during a walk, Tim’s enthusiasm is contagious and guaranteed to brighten your day. But don’t let all that energy fool you—Tim knows when it’s time to hit the pause button. He’s just as happy to kick back, relax, and watch the world go by from his favourite sunny spot. So, whether you’re an active adventurer who loves daily walks and play sessions or someone who enjoys calm, cozy moments at home, Tim’s easy-going nature means he’ll be your perfect sidekick. One of Tim’s best talents? His fantastic recall! Call his name, and he’ll come bounding over like a champ, ready for whatever’s next. He’s smart, eager to please, and loves showing off his tricks when given the chance. Tim is also a total social butterfly and gets along beautifully with feline friends, canine companions, and even young human pals. He’s the kind of dog who makes friends everywhere he goes and will happily share his space with the whole family. What makes Tim pawsome? 🐾 Zoomies champion and boundless fun-maker 🐾 Fantastic recall—he’ll come running every time! 🐾 Thrives in an active lifestyle but loves to relax, too 🐾 Gets along well with cats, dogs, and kids alike 🐾 Ready to be your faithful, furry partner-in-crime Tim can’t wait to meet you and start making memories full of fun, laughter, and maybe a few zoomies too!

NAME: Jacko
TEXT: Meet Jacko! Jacko is a confident, curious soul who's ready to find a forever home where he can truly shine. With a natural love for exploring the world around him, Jacko would thrive with a single person or a couple who can give him the time, space, and companionship he deserves. While Jacko adores human company, he prefers to be the only pet in the home so he can soak up all the love and attention. He may be open to meeting other dogs his size with slow, careful introductions — but he’s happiest when he has his own space to relax and play. This smart boy has fantastic recall and responds beautifully when out and about, making adventures together a real pleasure. He also enjoys his downtime with toys and will happily entertain himself or engage in a gentle game with his humans. If you're looking for a loyal, playful, and independent companion who's ready to explore life by your side, Jacko might just be your perfect match. Key Info: ✅ Best as a solo pet ✅ Confident and curious ✅ Slower intros with other dogs his size ✅ Excellent recall ✅ Loves toys and enrichment ✅ Ideal for a single person or couple Jacko is ready to meet his person – could that be you?

NAME: Shadow
TEXT: Meet Shadow 🐾 Shadow is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound who’s happiest when he’s hanging out with his human family and preferably inside, where he can find the comfiest spot in the house and make it his own. Once he’s picked his perfect chill zone, you’ll barely know he’s there… until it’s time to play or snack, that is! Shadow gets along beautifully with other dogs and adores children of all ages. He’s calm, friendly, and takes everything in his stride, making him a lovely companion for a busy family or anyone looking for a relaxed but social dog. If you’ve got a cat, Shadow may need a slow and gentle introduction—he’s curious but polite, and with a bit of patience, there’s potential for peaceful cohabitation. Despite his relaxed nature, Shadow loves to play, especially a good game of fetch! He’ll light up when you grab a toy and is always ready for some fun in the yard or a quick burst of activity before heading back to his favourite snooze spot. And when the treats come out? Oh, you’ve got his full attention. This boy knows how to sit pretty for a snack and will happily hang out just to be near you. Shadow would thrive in a loving home where he can enjoy the best of both worlds: playtime and cuddle time. Whether you’re a family with kids, a home with other dogs, or someone looking for a loyal companion to share quiet moments and light hearted play, Shadow is ready to step into your life and into your heart.

NAME: Electra
TEXT: Meet Electra ⚡️ If you’re looking for a greyhound who’s equal parts laid-back lounge lizard and fun-sized firecracker, Electra might just be your perfect match. With a name like hers, you’d expect lightning bolts and chaos—but in reality, she’s a soft, snuggly sweetheart who knows how to bring just the right amount of sparkle to your everyday life. At home, Electra loves hanging out with her bestie, a little dachshund who she happily shares her space (and sometimes her toys) with. Their play sessions are adorable, and once they’re done, Electra is more than happy to curl up for a well-earned nap. She's got the whole play hard, nap harder lifestyle down to an art. She's had a taste of the good life on the road too—yep, Electra’s a caravan queen. Her idea of “roughing it” on a holiday? Sprawled out across the bed like royalty while the humans do all the work. No stress, no fuss—just a relaxed travel companion who brings nothing but good vibes (and a bit of bed-hogging). Fully toilet trained and a lover of routine, Electra is easy to live with and even easier to love. Got kids? She adores them. Other dogs? Great! Cats? No worries! She’s friendly, gentle, and has a beautifully balanced nature that makes her a dream addition to a wide variety of homes. Electra is the kind of girl who would thrive in a home with a semi-active lifestyle—think nice morning strolls, a bit of yard time (bonus points if there’s a bone involved), and plenty of time to kick back and soak up affection. She's just as happy as a solo dog, soaking up all the love herself, or as part of a dog-savvy family who wants a relaxed but playful companion. Electra is ready to light up your life!!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Meet Millie 👑🐾 Millie is the ultimate balance between max relax and life of the party, the definition of “Play Hard, Nap Harder”. One minute she’s tossing around her toys like she’s hosting her own doggy dance party, and the next she’s sprawled out on the couch like she’s been on holiday for three weeks. It's called range, and Millie has it! Confident with new people and unbothered by new surroundings, Millie walks into every room like she owns it—tail wagging, eyes sparkling, and ready to charm. She’s fully toilet trained (a lady has standards), and would be just as happy living in an apartment or a house, as long as there’s a soft spot to snooze and some humans to love. Millie lives peacefully with her dachshund buddy (though she suspects she’s the boss) and gets along wonderfully with young children—especially if they come with snacks. Speaking of snacks… treats and affection are the keys to this girl's heart, and she’ll never say no to a belly rub or a tasty reward for being her fabulous self. If you're after a confident, affectionate, treat-loving, toy-tossing nap queen who brings the perfect mix of fun and chill to your life, Millie is ready to move in and take over your heart (and maybe your couch).

NAME: Hammer
TEXT: Ready to nail the perfect companion? Meet Hammer 🐾 Hammer is the ultimate all-rounder—a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who gets along famously with other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it’s a tiny terrier or a big labrador, Hammer’s easy going nature means he’s ready to make friends wherever he goes. This lively boy absolutely loves his zoomies and would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can race around and let loose to his heart’s content. When he’s not zooming, Hammer is a wonderful family dog—gentle, affectionate, and great with people of all ages. He’s equally happy as a solo dog or as the perfect companion for a young couple looking for a loving, energetic friend. Hammer is a cuddler at heart and enjoys spending quiet moments snuggled up with his humans after a day of fun and play. His engaging personality and happy disposition make him a joy to be around, always eager to say hello and share some love. If you’re searching for a playful, affectionate, and well-rounded greyhound who’s ready to bring energy and warmth into your home, Hammer might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Big Boy
TEXT: Say hello to Big Boy 🐾 Big Boy is a gentle giant with a heart as big as his name! This confident and max relaxer greyhound is a true people pleaser who adores everyone—from dogs and cats to children of all ages. He’s got a warm, friendly nature that makes him an instant hit wherever he goes. While Big Boy loves socializing, he prefers to be the king of his castle and would do best as a solo dog in his forever home. That said, he’s always up for a fun doggy playdate to stretch his legs and enjoy some furry friendship time. He knows how to keep things chill and relaxed, so his play dates tend to be happy and harmonious affairs. Big Boy would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can soak up the sunshine, lounge on the grass, or explore at his own leisurely pace. He’s happiest when a family member is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys company but is also perfectly content to kick back and chill solo when needed. Whether he’s snoozing quietly or spending quality time cuddling with his humans, Big Boy’s laid-back vibe brings calm and comfort to any household. On walks, Big Boy is a star walker, calm and confident on the lead, making every outing a peaceful pleasure for both dog and human. If you’re looking for a lovable, relaxed companion who’s a true social butterfly with a preference for solo living and fun play dates, Big Boy could be your perfect match. Ready to settle in and steal your heart, he’s waiting to become the gentle giant of your family!

NAME: Mila
TEXT: Meet Mila 🐾 Mila is a wonderful greyhound who perfectly balances chill vibes with bursts of outgoing energy. She’s a playful girl who absolutely loves her toys—whether it’s a squeaky ball, a tug rope, or a plush friend, Mila will happily entertain herself and her humans with fun play sessions. But when it’s time to unwind, she transforms into the ultimate relaxed companion, happy to lounge quietly and enjoy some peaceful downtime. Mila’s engaging and friendly personality really shines when she meets new people. She’s curious and affectionate, always eager to make new human friends and soak up some attention and cuddles. Her warmth and charm make her a joy to be around, whether she’s greeting guests or spending quality time with her family. This sociable girl has a heart as big as her smile and gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes, sizes, and breeds. She especially loves hanging out with her fellow greyhounds, enjoying the gentle company and playfulness of her own kind. On walks, Mila is a model canine citizen—she walks calmly and politely on the lead, making every stroll a relaxing and enjoyable experience for both her and her humans. Mila would thrive in a home where she can enjoy a mix of fun, social time and quiet relaxation. She’s equally happy playing games, meeting new friends, or simply curling up beside you for some much-needed downtime. If you’re looking for a friendly, playful, and well-mannered greyhound with a lovely blend of energy and calm, Mila could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Meet Bob 🐾 Bob is a confident, charming, and super social boy who knows exactly how to win hearts wherever he goes. Having already experienced life in a loving home, Bob is no stranger to the comforts of family life and he’s ready to bring his fun-loving personality to his forever home. Bob’s outgoing nature means he’s always up for making new friends, whether they’re two-legged or four-legged. He gets along famously with other dogs and adores spending time with his human buddies, showering them with affection and tail-wagging excitement. But don’t let his social side fool you, Bob also has a streak of independence that makes him the perfect companion for someone who works during the day. He’s happy to chill solo, confident that his family will be back soon for some quality hangout time. One thing Bob absolutely loves? Zoomies! This energetic boy has a serious need for speed and bursts of playful energy that’ll have you laughing out loud as he zooms around like a furry rocket. That’s why a home with a backyard is top of his wish list—plenty of space to run, play, and unleash his inner speedster to his heart’s content. Whether he’s racing the wind, making new doggy friends, or curling up for some well-deserved cuddles, Bob brings joy, confidence, and a whole lot of fun wherever he goes. If you’re after a lively, loving, and independent greyhound who’s ready to become your best buddy, Bob might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Hunter
TEXT: Hunter is a gentle, social and friendly boy who is great with little kids, likes being indoors and can do stairs (so apartment living could be suitable!), and has a lovely relaxed temperament, making him suitable for many home types. His best fit if he is to live with another dog is one who's lived with dogs before as he has a bouncy approach and makes his love for his doggy friends well known with enthusiasm! He means well and would love a home with another dog. He walks nicely on the lead and would suit daily walks and adventures. He loves treats and enjoys getting engaged in training sessions. Meet Hunter at Western Sydney!

NAME: Willow
TEXT: Meet Willow 🌿 Willow is the embodiment of calm and relaxation, a gentle girl with a serene and easy going spirit. She takes her time to settle into new environments and may need a little patience while she warms up to her surroundings, but once she feels safe and confident, she truly blossoms. On walks, Willow might need a bit more training and encouragement on the lead at first, as it takes her a moment to find her rhythm but once she does, she loves to stretch out and fly with all the elegance and speed greyhounds are known for. Willow is a true cuddle lover and thrives on human affection. She prefers the company of people over other animals and will happily seek out a lap or a cozy spot beside her favourite humans to relax and unwind. Though she enjoys the occasional doggy company and is good around other dogs, she’s happiest when she’s close to her humans and soaking up their attention. Her calm and gentle nature makes her a wonderful companion for a peaceful home. She would do best in a patient, loving household where she can take her time to feel secure, build trust, and be showered with plenty of cuddles and gentle care. If you’re looking for a relaxed, affectionate girl who values quiet moments and steady companionship, Willow could be the perfect addition to your family. She’s ready to bring calm, comfort, and love into a home that appreciates her gentle spirit.

NAME: Yoshi
TEXT: Introducing Yoshi 🐾 Yoshi is a confident and friendly gentleman who truly thrives when surrounded by his fellow greyhounds. He’s a social butterfly who loves hanging out and bonding with his canine friends, making him a great fit for a home with other dogs. Yoshi has not been introduced to smaller pups. This playful boy has a big heart and a fun-loving spirit. He absolutely adores playing with his toys and will happily spend hours entertaining himself (and you!) with a good game. Yoshi’s energy and zest for life make him a joy to watch as he leaps and bounds with excitement. Yoshi would shine in a household with children, where his gentle and affectionate nature can be appreciated and reciprocated. A backyard would be ideal for him to run, explore, and play to his heart’s content, giving him plenty of space to enjoy his active lifestyle. Most of all, Yoshi loves his human friends deeply. He’s affectionate and loyal, always eager to be close to the people he trusts and adores. If you’re looking for a confident, playful, and loving greyhound who gets along well with other dogs and kids, Yoshi is ready to bring happiness and fun to your family!

NAME: Jett
TEXT: Meet Jett 🐾 Jett is a confident and outgoing boy with a heart full of love and energy. He has previously lived happily with small dogs, showing his friendly and adaptable nature, and he’s always ready to make new furry friends wherever he goes. This active boy thrives on plenty of exercise and stimulation, but he also knows how to switch gears and settle in for lots of cuddles and affection. Jett absolutely loves being close to his humans and will happily snuggle up whenever he gets the chance. His affectionate nature makes him a true companion who will brighten your days with his joyful spirit. Jett would do best in a home where someone is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys having company around and thrives when he’s not left alone for long periods. His confident and sociable personality means he’s ready to explore the world and enjoy new adventures with you by his side. If you’re looking for an energetic, loving, and confident greyhound who is great with smaller dogs and adores affection, Jett could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Fancy
TEXT: Say hello to Fancy 🐾 Fancy is a beautiful, graceful lady with a wonderfully calm and gentle nature. She’s the perfect travel buddy, happily settling into vehicles with ease and making every car journey a relaxed, stress-free experience. Whether it’s a short trip to the park or a longer drive, Fancy’s chill attitude means she’s comfortable wherever she goes. When it comes to walks, Fancy is an absolute delight. She walks politely on the lead, never pulling or rushing, and seems to appreciate every moment spent exploring at a steady, unhurried pace. Her easy going temperament means she’s not easily startled or overwhelmed, making her a confident and relaxed walker in all kinds of environments. Fancy is a true lover of the easy life. She’s happiest when she’s lounging in a cozy corner or basking in a sunny spot, soaking up the calm vibes. She’s content to relax quietly alongside her humans and enjoys a peaceful, gentle lifestyle. Despite her laid-back nature, Fancy also has a warm and friendly side that shines through when she meets new friends. One of Fancy’s standout qualities is her sociability. She gets along beautifully with dogs of all shapes and sizes, whether big or small, young or old. Her calm demeanour helps her fit seamlessly into multi-dog households. She’s also fantastic with children of all ages! Fancy would thrive in a home where she can enjoy a calm and stable environment, surrounded by people who appreciate her chilled-out nature and loving heart.

NAME: Macca
TEXT: This is Macca! What a sweetheart; a friendly energetic girl with beautiful brown eyes and a pretty face that will steal your heart. Macca is full of fun and playfulness—she loves toys, playtime, and pats, and just wants to get your attention, really. She would do well with some quiet downtime with her humans and best as an only dog or with another grey. She would thrive in a home with someone with the time to give her some calming guidance, lead practice, and the love she deserves to show her true potential. Macca would be a loyal companion who will return your love tenfold. If you're looking for a devoted best friend with a wagging tail, a soft heart and a skip in her step, Macca's your girl!

NAME: Quail
TEXT: Quail is sweet boy, entering his golden years and looking for a place to call home! Gentle by nature, Quail loves pats and affection from his human friends and enjoys getting out and about for a stroll, walking gently on lead along the way. He pairs well with other Greyhounds, so pending a meet and greet, may suit a home with another medium to large breed. Quail is happy lounging around or catching some rays in the morning sun. He's shown to settle well indoors and on his own so may suit an apartment or townhouse set up or a home with someone who works part time or full time, with a chance to work up to long hours alone. A calm, quiet environment to match his laid back energy would be great for this handsome guy! Meet Quail at Western Sydney!

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris – the ultimate gentleman! Boris is a calm, gentle, and easy-going boy with the softest nature. He has been living with an 83-year-old companion and walks beautifully by his side on his walking frame, never pulling ahead — a true gentleman. He’s also wonderful with kids from babies to teens, friendly with little dogs, cats, and dogs of all sizes. Boris enjoys relaxed walks by the park, never straying too far from you, car rides, and of course, lounging beside you at home for cuddles. He's a true couch potato with a chill, happy demeanour. Lazy, moi? Boris is looking for a comfy couch to call his own and a loving home where he can share his gentle nature every day. His previous adopter had to move into a nursing home and, unfortunately, was unable to take Boris with him. He would be perfect for retirees with grandchildren or smaller yards (not much of a zoomie man) or blend in with a busy family or couple with or without other pets. What a beautiful soul 💛

NAME: Pepper
TEXT: Pepper is a funny girl who will fetch toys and have a morning zoomie. She then wipes out pretty quickly and is content just keeping you company. If she hasn't got access to a yard she is pretty content to go for a local walk. She is great with everyone she meets and loves kids.

NAME: Alice
TEXT: Alice is a smart and social girl who’s mastered the art of stairs,so apartment living? No problem for this savvy pup! Whether you live in a cozy city flat or a spacious home, Alice adapts with ease and grace. She’s friendly with medium to large dogs and would be just as happy with a furry friend to hang out with as she would flying solo as the queen of the castle. Alice is a pro at settling and can chill for long stretches, making her perfect for busy households. Even if you work full time, she’ll happily keep your couch warm and ready for cuddle sessions when you’re home. no “mad tea parties” required. If you’re after a laid-back, loving companion who’s equal parts social butterfly and Netflix buddy, Alice is ready to tumble down your rabbit hole and steal your heart!

NAME: Libby
TEXT: Libby is a little sweetheart who adores affection. She responds well to her name and plays nicely with toys. She becomes friends with everyone she meets and has had positive experiences meeting a diverse range of animals on her current property native and domestic.

NAME: Kala
TEXT: Kala is strapping young lad who is a big cuddly softie. He just wants to be part of the family. He is happy to supervise while your working hard around the yard and is happy to fetch toys and drop them at your feet. Kala is destined to be a valued family member with a lot of love to give. Great with everyone he meets.

NAME: Magic
TEXT: Meet Magic, a greyhound who lives up to his name—he’s full of spark, joy, and a touch of mischief! Magic is an energetic and playful boy who loves to get out and explore the world. He walks with confidence and enthusiasm, making him the perfect adventure buddy for a family that enjoys being active. Whether it’s a stroll through the park or a weekend outing, Magic brings excitement and fun wherever he goes. Magic’s outgoing nature comes with plenty of good manners—he’s polite and social with other dogs and has happily walked alongside both medium to large breeds and smaller companions without fuss. He would likely enjoy sharing a home with another greyhound or dog friend pending a meet and greet. Once he’s had time to settle and learn the comforts of home life, Magic will be content to spend some time on his own too. If you’re looking for a lively, affectionate companion who’s ready to add a little sparkle to your days, Magic might just be the perfect addition to your family

NAME: Marshall
TEXT: Marshall is a lovable guy who’s happiest when he’s right by your side,he’ll follow you around like your own little shadow, eager to be involved in all your daily adventures. He’d do best in a home where someone’s around more often then not to help him settled into pet life. Marshall also needs a yard to roam and explore since settling inside can be a bit tricky for him,though he does have a soft spot for his crate, which he finds cosy and calming.
