He’s great with kids 10 and up, and while he’s okay with medium to large dogs when out and about, he really prefers being the star of the show at home,so a single-dog household would be his dream come true. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s part shadow, part cuddle bug, and 100% ready to steal your heart, Marshall’s your guy!

NAME: Geisha
TEXT: Say hello to Geisha 🐶 Geisha is a beautiful lady with a calm presence, a gentle spirit, and a love for life’s simple pleasures. She has the kind of soothing energy that fills a room without saying a word – just her being there makes everything feel a little more peaceful. True to her name, Geisha moves with grace and serenity, but don’t let that elegant exterior fool you – she’s also got a wonderfully playful streak! When it comes to other dogs, Geisha is a total pro. She’s incredibly dog-social and happy to live with canine companions of all shapes and sizes. Whether she’s gently playing, quietly snoozing next to them, or just sharing her space, she does it all with ease and friendliness. Geisha is what we like to call “effortlessly easy.” She’s wonderfully relaxed, low-maintenance, and happy to go with the flow. She’ll adapt to your routine without complaint and will be your quiet shadow, following you from room to room with calm curiosity. She doesn’t ask for much – just a soft bed, some gentle affection, and maybe a toy or two to keep her entertained. One of her favourite things is simply being close to her humans. She thrives on gentle affection and will happily rest her head in your lap or snuggle in close for some quiet bonding time. She’s affectionate without being needy – just a sweet, steady presence who’s always nearby when you need a bit of comfort or company. Geisha is ready to find her forever home – could it be with you?

NAME: Joe
TEXT: Meet Joe 🐾 Joe is a confident and cheerful gentleman with a tail that never stops wagging! Full of personality and charm, Joe carries himself with a happy-go-lucky attitude and a healthy dose of independence. He knows what he likes — whether it's a good sniff around the backyard or a comfy spot to lounge in, but he’s always happy to come over for a cuddle and soak up all the affection you're willing to give. Joe is great with medium and large dogs, showing good manners and a calm approach. He’s still learning about smaller dogs, so slow and gentle introductions will be key. With the right guidance, he’s a smart boy who’s always up for learning something new. This lovely lad would thrive in a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs and enjoy some solo sunbathing time. Joe’s independent streak means he’s not overly clingy, but he still loves having his humans around — especially if they’re up for some playtime or pats. He’d be best suited to a home with older children who can match his energy and give him the space he needs to relax and feel secure. If you're looking for a happy, affectionate, and self-assured greyhound to brighten your days, Joe could be just the guy for you! 🐶

NAME: Cricket
TEXT: 🏏 Meet Cricket 🐾 Cricket is a handsome boy with a heart as gentle as his soul. This laid-back boy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. Whether he's lounging at home or exploring the world, Cricket takes everything in stride with his signature relaxed vibe. A true gentleman around other dogs, Cricket gets along effortlessly with his canine companions and never causes a fuss. He’s incredibly easy to handle, making walks and outings a breeze. He also travels beautifully in the car, just hop in, buckle up, and Cricket is ready for the ride, no complaints. Cricket has a soft spot for his human buddies and loves coming up for pats and gentle affection. He may not be over-the-top with his attention, but his quiet loyalty and sweet nature speak volumes. He’s always happy to hang out by your side, offering calm company and the occasional nuzzle. If you're looking for a mellow, well-mannered greyhound who fits into just about any lifestyle, Cricket might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Ginny
TEXT: Meet Ginny 🐾 Looking for a chilled-out companion with a heart full of love? Ginny is your girl! This sweet greyhound is the perfect mix of relaxed and affectionate. She gets along wonderfully with medium and large dogs, making her a fantastic companion for furry friends her size. While Ginny has been around smaller dogs before, she does get a little excited, so a slow, careful introduction is key to help her feel comfortable and build new friendships. Ginny adores her crate, where she loves to relax and recharge. She's always eager to check in with her humans, seeking attention and affection. Whether it's lounging on the couch or enjoying a leisurely walk, Ginny is content to be by your side. If you're looking for a loyal, loving companion who enjoys both downtime and human connection, Ginny might just be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Mary
TEXT: Mary is a lovely girl who is happy to lounge around and keep you company. Once she has some mild exercise she is content to chill out. She is a charming girl who adores affection and being in your presence. She walks well on the lead, is social with other dogs and will chase a ball a couple of times before she has had enough. She would make an excellent companion.

NAME: Molly
TEXT: Molly is a stunning and confident girl ready to become friends with everybody. She walks well on the lead and is happy making new friends. I have seen her become friends with medium and large dogs that she meets. She has not had much play time around small dogs but that doesn't mean she wouldn't be friendly with them also. She is comfortable at home in the yard while your at work also as she is living that type of life already.

NAME: Tuggie
TEXT: Meet Tuggie! 🐾 Tuggie is a calm and relaxed boy with a surprisingly big personality that instantly wins hearts. He’s the perfect blend of chill vibes and playful spirit, whether he’s contentedly lounging with his favourite toy or gearing up for a lively game, Tuggie brings a special kind of joy to every moment. This easy going guy fits beautifully into an active lifestyle. He loves joining his humans for walks, playtime, or just hanging out and soaking up the good vibes. His mellow nature means he’s happy to relax and recharge when the action winds down, but don’t be fooled, when the mood strikes, Tuggie loves to get playful and show off his fun-loving side. Tuggie adores children and thrives in their company, making him a wonderful family companion. He also gets along wonderfully with medium to large dogs, happily sharing play sessions and quiet moments alike. Although he hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, his gentle and easy going temperament makes us hopeful he’d adjust well given the right introductions. One of Tuggie’s favourite pastimes is playing with his toys.. His big personality shines brightest when he’s engaged in fun, but he’s equally content cuddling up for some downtime with his humans. If you’re looking for a loving, laid-back buddy who can keep up with an active family but also knows how to relax and enjoy the quiet moments, Tuggie is the perfect match. With his balance of calm and playful energy, plus a heart full of affection, he’s ready to bring lots of love and joy into your life.

NAME: Mouse
TEXT: Meet Mouse! 🐭 Don’t let her name fool you—Mouse is a lively, joyful girl with a heart and energy much bigger than her name suggests! Currently living with a playful puppy, Mouse has proven herself to be fantastic with all dogs, big and small, and she’s equally friendly with cats. She’s the ultimate social butterfly who truly thrives in a busy, loving home filled with furry friends. Mouse absolutely adores children and is happiest when she has little buddies to play with. She’s got endless energy and is more than willing to keep up with the kiddos, happily playing for hours on end. Whether it’s chasing toys, engaging in games of fetch, or simply hopping around the house with excitement, Mouse brings an infectious joy to every moment. Her playful spirit means there’s never a dull day with her around! But it’s not all zoomies and play—Mouse has a wonderfully affectionate side, too. She loves to give and receive affection, making her a sweet cuddle companion once the fun winds down. Her gentle nature means she’s great with everyone she meets, and she thrives on the loving connections she builds with her humans and animal friends alike. Having spent a good deal of time living outdoors, Mouse is comfortable in a variety of environments and enjoys exploring new places with a curious nose and wagging tail. She loves a good adventure, sniffing around the yard or hopping from room to room, always eager to discover what’s next.

NAME: Nitro
TEXT: Meet Nitro! ⚡️ Nitro is a lively guy who knows how to strike the perfect balance between zoomies and chill time. When he’s feeling energetic, he’ll happily race around the yard like a little lightning bolt, showing off his speedy moves and playful spirit. But just as quickly, he’s just as content curling up beside you for some serious relaxation and quality cuddle time. Nitro is a true social butterfly in the pet world. He’s cat-friendly and dog-friendly, making him an ideal member of a multi-pet household. Whether he’s sharing space with feline friends or canine companions, Nitro is easy-going, respectful, and gets along famously with everyone. Plus, he’s fantastic with children of all ages; gentle, patient, and always ready to be part of the family fun. This affectionate boy absolutely thrives on attention and love. He’s the type of dog who will happily follow you around the house just to be near you, eagerly accepting all the pets, scratches, and belly rubs you can offer. Nitro’s love tank is bottomless, and he’s not shy about letting you know when he needs a little extra TLC. Nitro also appreciates his crate—a cozy, safe haven where he can retreat when he wants some downtime or a peaceful nap after a busy day of adventures and play. He’s well-behaved, adaptable, and loves having a comfy spot to call his own. If you’re searching for a loving, well-rounded companion who fits seamlessly into a bustling household, Nitro might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Bat Man
TEXT: Meet Bat Man! 🦇 Don’t let the name fool you—Bat Man is a laid-back greyhound with a heart as soft as his adorable fluffy coat. He’s happiest when surrounded by his fellow greyhounds, loving their company and enjoying the calm, easy-going life of a true greyhound gentleman. Bat Man hasn’t been tested with smaller dogs yet, but he’s got such a chilled-out nature that we’re hopeful he’d take things in stride with the right introduction. This easy going guy adores his human friends and is always up for some quality time; whether it’s a gentle pat, a slow stroll, or just hanging out together. He’s happy to cruise about at his own relaxed pace, taking in the world with a contented smile. Bat Man’s combination of chilled vibes, fluffy charm, and love for his greyhound pals makes him a wonderful companion for someone looking to add a calm, affectionate friend to their home.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Meet Luna! 🌙 Luna is a playful, affectionate greyhound who truly shines when she’s around her fellow greyhounds. She’s a social butterfly in the best way, always ready to say hello, share a sniff, and join in the fun with her greyhound pals. While Luna hasn’t yet been tested with smaller dogs, her gentle and friendly nature makes us hopeful she’d adapt well with the right introductions and a bit of patience. One thing Luna absolutely loves? Treats. Mention the word, and she’s all ears—and wagging tail! She’s a smart cookie who’s eager to learn, especially when there’s a tasty reward involved. Whether it’s training new tricks or simply earning a little extra love, Luna is motivated and ready to impress. When it comes to car rides, Luna is an absolute star. She travels well, staying calm and content whether you’re running errands or heading out on a longer adventure. This makes her a perfect companion for families or individuals who love to explore new places together. On the leash, Luna can be a little enthusiastic and might pull at first! But once she settles into her stride, she walks beautifully, happy to take in all the sights and smells with you at her side. Luna’s playful side shines through in her everyday life. She loves to have fun, chase toys, and enjoy some lively playtime, but she’s just as happy to curl up close for some affection. She’s a loving girl with a heart full of joy and plenty of love to spread around. If you’re looking for a cheerful, loving greyhound who adores company, Luna might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Rosey
TEXT: Meet Rosie! 👑 Rosie is the definition of a gentle soul wrapped in a fluffy greyhound package. She would absolutely thrive as the one and only pet in a calm, loving household. Her royal status means she prefers all the attention (and snuggles!) for herself. This affectionate queen adores her human buddies and is happiest when she’s close by, sharing quiet moments or gentle cuddles. Rosie loves her crate—a cozy little castle where she feels safe and content, and she’s always ready to retreat there for some peaceful downtime. While she enjoys a little adventure and loves to explore her surroundings with curiosity, Rosie’s true passion is chilling out and soaking up the good vibes of a relaxed home. Happy and easy going, she brings calm and warmth wherever she goes. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s all about affection, gentle cuddles, and being your one-and-only, Rosie’s ready to be your queen and your best friend for life.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Meet Dolly! 🐾 If you’re looking for a greyhound with more zoomies than a rocket ship and more confidence than a dog who just found the best stick in the park, Dolly is your girl! This strong, sleek speedster LOVES to run circles around her greyhound buddies, she’s basically the social butterfly of the greyhound world. Dolly is fantastic with other greyhounds and could probably teach a masterclass in making furry friends. Smaller dogs? Well, she hasn’t met many yet, so we’re keeping that adventure open for the future—think of it as a “coming soon” episode in the Dolly saga! This girl has impeccable recall, which means when you call her, she’s basically a furry missile zooming back to you (unless she’s mid-zoomie, then you might just be part of the fun chase). She’s strong too, so if you’re ready for some workout sessions disguised as dog walks, Dolly’s got you covered. She’d be happiest with a backyard where she can unleash those famous zoomies and show off her impressive speed and grace (or maybe just run in hilarious circles). Dolly’s confidence means she can fit comfortably into most homes, as long as you’re ready for some lively fun and lots of tail wags. In short: Dolly is the four-legged combination of a sprinter, socialite, and comedian—all wrapped up in a gorgeous greyhound package. Are you ready for zoomies, belly rubs, and endless fun? Because Dolly definitely is!

NAME: Jack (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Gentle, calm, and loving Jack is looking for a family where he can have human company, and is looking for someone who adores him. He has shown overall highly calm and affectionate traits here at the centre and we think he'd be happiest with someone home all the time for him. He is suitable around other calm, likeminded Medium-Large dogs, however still requires a human presence. He walks beautifully on the lead, and is ready to accompany you just about anywhere you go. Jack just wants to be by your side, all the time! Jack would love a house with a yard. A home without stairs is best suited. Jack can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West* Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Levina
TEXT: Hi, I'm Levina! I travel super nicely in cars, promise to walk well on the lead for all our adventures, and I love mingling with other dogs! I love meeting new people and think I'm the bubbly happy type, pretty easy going and able to get along with any crowd! As for my perfect home, I'd love a backyard and some kids to keep me entertained. I like sitting in the office with my GAP staff so an apartment home wouldn't be out of the question with shorter hours alone. Come meet me via appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I have just aced my 8 weeks of foster care and I'm ready to go home with you!* Foster Update: "Matey is going great, enjoys his walks, enrichment toys and especially enjoys food! He now comes inside and runs straight to his bed and lies down, without me even needing to tell him, we are blown away with how well he is going!" Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and gentle, curious and affectionate nature, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet Blaze, a sweet guy looking for a place to call home. Blaze is a playful and affectionate guy, who with a bit of time to warm up will be your bestfriend! He loves his treats and has responded well to his training while here with us at the centre. He's loved his interactions with his greyhound buddies so could join a home with another medium to large breed dog, pending a meet and greet. He can tackle our training stairs with ease and could work up to being left a lone for longer periods of time. Blaze would prefer a home with adults or a family with adult children. Come down to Western Sydney to meet Blaze.

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Meet Elsa! 🐾 Elsa is a bright, outgoing lady who absolutely adores children and makes friends wherever she goes! Full of energy and curiosity, Elsa is a true little adventurer who loves exploring new places and sniffing out exciting smells. She’s always up for a walk, a run, or a fun day out discovering the world around her. Elsa’s friendly and affectionate nature means she bonds quickly with everyone she meets—whether that’s kids, other dogs, or new people. She’s great with other dogs, enjoying playtime and company, but she also knows when it’s time to relax and soak up some cuddles. Her love of treats makes training and learning new tricks a breeze, and she’s always ready to show off a happy wag or two! If you’re looking for a loving, lively companion who will bring energy, affection, and lots of joy to your family, Elsa is your girl. She’s ready to leap into your life with boundless enthusiasm and fill your days with fun adventures and warm snuggles. Could Elsa be the energetic and loving friend you’ve been waiting for?

NAME: Tipsy
TEXT: Meet Tipsy! 🐾 Tipsy is the ultimate chill greyhound girl who knows how to keep things calm and happy wherever she goes. This lovely lady is as easy-going as they come; quiet, gentle, and just a little bit sweetly goofy. She’s got a heart full of love and gets along famously with every dog she meets, making her a superstar in the social scene. Whether you’re living the busy family life or enjoying peaceful solo days, Tipsy adapts with ease and would be a perfect fit for almost any home. She’s the kind of girl who’ll lounge happily by your side, content and relaxed, but is also happy to hop in the car or van for a little adventure, she travels like a dream! If you’re after a calm, friendly, and wonderfully well-mannered companion who’s ready to fill your days with quiet joy and unconditional love, Tipsy is your girl. Ready to meet your new best friend?

NAME: Josie
TEXT: Josie is a sweet, tiny (23kg!), shy and gorgeous girl who would benefit from living with a canine companion, in a quiet home/lifestyle. This pretty lady has been working on her confidence here at the centre but would benefit from a home with no children to begin her journey into pet life. Her signature move is to put her nose on you for pats, showing her affectionate and curious side! She gets a lot of confidence from being with another dog so if you have another calm and nurturing canine friend we'd love to hear from you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Shadow (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Shadow is a sweet, social boy who wouldn't mind sharing his forever home with another dog of any size, pending a meet and greet. He is currently spending some time in foster care with a small dog who he is getting along with very well! He has so far settled into his foster home wonderfully and copes well throughout the day being left alone in the backyard. Shadow has wonderful lead manners and has also done well with his crate training although he'd be more than happy without one in his new home. Shadow is currently in a foster home, doing brilliantly and can't wait to find his forever home. If you're looking for a new best mate or a new addition to your family, Shadow might just be the guy for you. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Hope
TEXT: Meet Hope! A sweet girl, who adores people and is happiest when she's close to her humans, especially if there's a couch and a cuddle involved! Hope would thrive in a home where someone is around more often than not, to help settle her in to her new life. She’s confident on stairs, loves exploring the yard, and would love a home with some outdoor space to stretch her legs and catch some rays. She may be able to share her new home with another medium to large dog, pending a successful meet and greet. Hope is best suited to a home with older children (10+) who can respect her gentle nature. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion to share your home (and your couch) with, meet Hope at Western Sydney! 🐾

NAME: Carey
TEXT: Carey has been around dogs big and small, and walks well on the lead. He is great around new people and enjoys spending time sniffing around new places. He would enjoy a fun life with a family, a backyard/townhouse and a good routine. He has met big dogs and small dogs at the adoption centre. Carey is social, sweet and ready to find his perfect forever home! Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Myrtle
TEXT: Hey, I'm Myrtle! I'm an affectionate, friendly and well rounded girl. I am friendly with dogs big and small and would love to find a family who will include me in daily family life. I would suit a home with a yard to sunbake, do zoomies and spend time sniffing the breeze. Daily walkies would be super fun, too! I would be happy living with respectful kids due to my friendly nature. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a sweet, quiet girl, who is lovely and soft with other dogs. She warms up well once you get to know her and becomes very sweet and affectionate. Cindy would suit a nurturing home where they can take things slow, but we're sure she will come out of her shell! A quiet home with a backyard to retreat to would be a perfect match for Cindy as she settles into pet life. A home without little kids is best suited as she is on the shy side. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jeda
TEXT: Jeda is a sweet girl who warms up nicely and has little excitable moments including chasing toys around. This gorgeous girl is excitable/confident and walks beautifully on the lead. She is a sweet girl who would suit a home with another greyhound buddy and a backyard to call her own. Jeda is as gorgeous inside as she is out - we can't wait for you to meet her! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tails
TEXT: Meet Tails 🐕‍🦺 Tails is a sweet and sensitive girl who would truly flourish with a little extra support and patience. While she can be timid and shy when meeting new people, once she feels safe and comfortable, she blossoms into a loving and loyal companion. Tails would hugely benefit from foster care or a home with another well-adjusted dog to help show her the ropes of pet life. Having a confident canine friend by her side will give her the guidance and reassurance she needs to gain confidence in her new surroundings. She gets along well with other dogs and enjoys their company, but she thrives best in a calm, low-key lifestyle where she can take things at her own pace without feeling overwhelmed. If you have a gentle home and a furry friend willing to help Tails settle in, you could be the perfect match to help this beautiful girl come out of her shell and experience all the love and joy she deserves.

NAME: Cc
TEXT: Meet CC 🐾 !! Say hello to CC, a stunning girl with a heart full of love and a personality that lights up any room. Despite her age, CC doesn’t act her years… she’s got a youthful, playful spirit that makes her a joy to be around every single day. CC is the epitome of calm and relaxed. She moves through life with a gentle, easy-going nature that makes her a wonderful companion for just about anyone. She gets along beautifully with all dogs, whether they’re big, small, shy, or outgoing, CC embraces them all with her friendly and inclusive attitude. Her love for humans is just as big as her love for treats (and trust us, she really loves her treats!). CC thrives on affection and enjoys every moment spent with her people, whether it’s cuddling on the couch, going for peaceful walks, or just soaking up the good vibes around her. She’s the perfect fit for almost any household, whether you’re a busy family looking for a calm canine member, a couple wanting a loving companion, or even someone who already has other pets. CC’s easy-going nature, friendliness, and adaptability mean she’ll settle in quickly and become a cherished member of your family. If you’re searching for a loyal, gentle, and incredibly sweet dog who will fill your home with warmth and happiness, CC is the one you’ve been waiting for. Ready to share her love and her treats with you, she’s sure to steal your heart!

NAME: Tim Tam
TEXT: Whether you're a double coat, caramel or an original Tim Tam fan, we can all agree Tim Tams are a sweet treat and a family favourite. He is the perfect blend of calm natured and sometimes playful, what more could you want in a canine companion. He walks lovely on the lead and would suit a home without exposure to small dogs. Tim Tam gets along with dogs his size. Due to his friendly nature, he will suit a family that have respectful children. Tim Tam comes when called and is polite around new people! Tim Tam is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wooly
TEXT: Hey, I'm Wooly! I'm a quiet guy, looking for a quiet home. I warm up to new people but would prefer a nurturing chilled out place to call my own. I'd love my own backyard and don't mind mingling with other dogs big or small. I love food and will enjoy learning new tricks in my forever home. A home without children is best for me. I can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Brax
TEXT: Meet Brax 🐾! Brax is a delightful boy with a playful and affectionate personality that instantly wins hearts. He’s had wonderful experience being around small children, showing a calm and gentle demeanour that makes him a fantastic addition to family life. Brax has also seen chickens and cats during his time, though he hasn’t been formally tested with them, so a slow, supervised introduction would help everyone feel comfortable. This handsome boy loves the company of other medium to large dogs and enjoys socializing and playing with his furry pals. Whether it’s a lively play session or just hanging out side by side, Brax thrives in a dog-friendly environment where he can be active and engaged. While he’s full of playful energy, Brax also knows how to relax and truly enjoys lying in his crate, which he finds cozy and safe and a perfect spot to recharge after a busy day. One of his most lovable traits is how much he loves to show affection. He’s not shy about letting you know when he wants some love, and he delights in offering cuddles and warm moments to those he trusts. Brax is looking for a forever home where he can be part of a loving family who appreciates his playful spirit and gentle heart. If you’re seeking a sweet, social, and affectionate greyhound who’s great with kids and loves spending time with other dogs, Brax might be the perfect fit for you!

NAME: Turtle
TEXT: Meet Turtle 🐢! Turtle is a truly beautiful greyhound with a sleek, shiny coat and a striking presence that turns heads wherever he goes. But don’t let his elegant looks fool you—this boy is full of energy, strength, and playful spirit! He’s a strong, athletic dog who loves to engage in fun, active play sessions, so he would thrive best in a home with other big dogs who can match his pace and with older kids who understand how to interact with a lively, robust canine companion. Turtle would prefer to live in a house where he has plenty of space to move around, explore, and feel comfortable. While he enjoys his energetic playtime, he also has a big heart and absolutely adores affection and attention from his humans. Whether it’s a good belly rub, a cozy cuddle, or just being near the people he loves, Turtle is happiest when showered with love. Another great thing about Turtle is that he’s crate trained, which means he’s not only fun and affectionate but also well-behaved and easy to manage in a family setting. He’s looking for a forever home where he can be part of an active family who understands his playful nature and can provide the exercise, companionship, and care he deserves. If you’re looking for a loyal, strong, and loving companion who will fill your home with joy and energy, Turtle is the perfect boy for you!

NAME: Jill (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Jill is a confident, friendly and affectionate girl described as 'wonderful' by her trainers here at the adoption centre. If you're looking for a super smart and focused girl, Jill's known cues are: name/recall, 'on your bed', off, down, touch, shake, chin rest, and drop (a toy). Jill loves toys & will play fetch with you. Her ideal home is a house with a backyard with colorbond fencing with shorter hours alone while she settles in. Jill requires a home without exposure to other dogs and requires an owner who lives in a low small dog populated area. She would thrive with an experienced greyhound owner who can continue her human engagement, training, focus training, and things like stationing on a bed, performing cues and recalling. She is happy to entertain herself in the yard during the day making her a good fit for those who work full-time and want a loving companion welcome them home everyday. Meet Jill at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spring
TEXT: Meet Spring! 🌼 Spring is a sweet-natured girl with a heart as soft as her gorgeous greyhound coat. She’s one of those dogs who makes life easier just by being around – relaxed, gentle, and incredibly easy to handle. Whether you’re an experienced dog owner or new to life with pups, Spring fits in effortlessly. She’s a real social butterfly, getting along brilliantly with all other dogs and loving the company of people. If you’ve got visitors, expect Spring to be first in line for a gentle hello and a little tail wag. She's a friendly soul who just wants to be included in the love. Spring would be a great fit for a family home, including one with respectful children. Her calm and steady personality makes her a safe and lovely companion for little ones. While she’s a joy in almost every way, Spring is still working on perfecting her lead manners – nothing too tricky, just a bit of ongoing training and consistency, and she’ll have it down in no time. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance, and loving dog who enjoys companionship and will bring a peaceful energy to your home, Spring could be your perfect match.

NAME: Bailey
TEXT: Meet Bailey – your happy blue best mate! Bailey is a beautiful, friendly blue boy who adores kids (6+) and loves nothing more than a game of chase, plenty of pats, and sniffing the young girl's hair just to make her giggle. He’s a joyful, affectionate lad who’s sure to bring laughter, love, and warmth into his new home. Bailey gets along well with his Greyhound pals as well as smaller dog friends (like a Mini Groodle, Mini Foxy, Pug, and Kelpie x), so he’d happily share his home with another friendly dog, even an indoor cat. He’s doing well inside, is nearly house-trained, and easy to take on walks. If you’re looking for a loving, playful chap who’s great with kids and ready to be part of the family, Bailey’s your boy!

NAME: Roxie
TEXT: About Roxie: Calm and independent girl who enjoys her own space. Socialised and friendly with small dogs. Quiet and relaxed at home — the perfect low-maintenance companion. Lights up when it’s time for a walk or an adventure! Easy to have around and settles beautifully into routine. Ideal Home: A peaceful home that appreciates her gentle, independent nature. Someone who enjoys daily walks and the occasional outing. Secure yard and a comfy bed where she can relax and recharge.

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Gentle giant with a loving, loyal nature. Fantastic with kids — patient and affectionate. Responds well to training and eager to please. Enjoys playtime and would love a secure yard to stretch his legs. Happy to chill out after a good walk or play session. Sociable and thrives on being part of the family.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Meet Cindy – Pretty, Playful & Ready for Love! What a happy, pretty girl Cindy is! With her gorgeous white coat sprinkled with brindle patches, fawn and black spots, a brindle ear and a black ear, she’s truly one of a kind. Cindy is a funny, gentle soul who adores playing in the backyard with the grandkids (6, 8, and 10), especially when they help with her feeding after school. She’s lived mostly on the farm, calmly ignoring the livestock behind the fence. This lovely lady is content to rest in the sun or on her bed and is happy to amuse herself during the day, making her a wonderful companion for a working household, retirees or families. Now reaching her senior years, Cindy would love to find a family of her own to spoil her with love and comfort.

NAME: Paul
TEXT: Isn't Paul the cutest little guy? Meet Paul, a super calm and polite boy. Paul is charming and laid back, your quintessential cool calm and collected greyhound. He is sweet, positive and engaging. He has mingled well with big and small dogs, thanks to his tolerant and generous nature, we think he would suit a home with another dog/s. He'd also do well with quiet and laid back children and a home ready to enjoy the peace and calm vibes of such a laid back boy like Paul. Meet Paul via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a happy, vibrant and energetic girl who is affectionate and social! She loves all the fun things in pet life - treats, zoomies, attention and play! She would love a fun active home to keep her stimulated and meet her training and enrichment needs. She is very friendly, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She would suit kids experienced with large breed dogs. A fully fenced yard with somewhere for her to romp around and sunbake would be ideal for Belle! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Dina
TEXT: Hi, I'm Dina, I'm a shy but sweet girl looking for someone to nurture and calm my nerves. I am sweet and polite and I promise to be your new best friend, I'm just a little unsure when I first meet you. I take a bit of time to warm up, so I'd like a quiet neck of the woods to call my own, maybe a house with a quiet yard or a nice property to relax on. I am polite, calm and friendly around other dogs, too! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Rev
TEXT: Meet Rev ⚡! Rev is a handsome and energetic boy who loves nothing more than making new friends—both human and canine alike. With excellent recall, he’s eager to listen and respond, but he does have a strong lead presence that means he’d benefit from a bit more training to help him channel all that enthusiasm in the best way possible. Rev is incredibly social and friendly, and he’ll always be the first to say hi with a wagging tail and a big smile. His love for other greyhounds is clear—he thrives when he’s around his own kind, enjoying playful interactions and company that keeps his spirits high. An explorer at heart, Rev is happiest when he’s out and about, taking in new sights and scents with boundless curiosity and energy. He’s ready for an active home that can keep up with his zest for life and support his ongoing training to help him become the best version of himself. If you’re looking for a friendly, lively, and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to share adventures and endless greetings, Rev is your guy!

NAME: Lilly
TEXT: Meet Lilly 💕! Lilly is a lovely and sweet girl who has been raised surrounded by children, making her wonderfully comfortable and gentle around little ones. She truly thrives in a lively, family-oriented environment where the sounds of laughter and play are a regular part of her day. Her calm and patient nature means she’s great with kids of all ages, enjoying their company and the chance to be part of family fun. Lilly is a social butterfly when it comes to her fellow canines and loves making new doggy friends. She would do best living with another dog, as she enjoys the companionship, playtime, and comfort that comes with having a canine buddy by her side. Whether it’s a gentle snuggle or a little playful romp, Lilly’s heart is happiest when shared with her four-legged pals. One of Lilly’s most endearing qualities is her affectionate nature. She’s a true cuddle enthusiast who will happily approach you for pats, hugs, and belly rubs whenever she’s in the mood. Her love is unconditional and freely given, making her a devoted companion who loves nothing more than to be close to her people. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving, and loyal girl who will fit right into a family setting and shower you with affection, Lilly is the perfect match. She’s ready to bring warmth, love, and happiness into a home where she can continue to thrive surrounded by the ones she loves most.

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Meet Gem 💎! This gorgeous girl has a heart full of love and a gentle, shy nature that takes a little time to come out of her shell. At first, Gem might feel a bit reserved as she gets used to new surroundings and people, but with patience and a calm environment, she quickly settles in and reveals her true, loving self. Gem would thrive best in a household where someone is usually around—whether working from home, part-time, or just a steady presence—so she never feels alone and can build her confidence at her own pace. One of Gem’s greatest joys is spending time with her doggy friends. She loves to play and interact with other dogs, showing her friendly and sociable side once she feels comfortable. Gem also adores children and enjoys their playful energy, making her a wonderful companion for families with kids who can engage her in gentle games and fun activities. Though she may start off a little shy, once Gem has warmed up to you, she’s a total cuddle queen. She loves curling up close, soaking in affection, and sharing those quiet, cozy moments that truly bond a dog and their human. Her sweet, gentle spirit shines through in these calm times, reminding you just how special she is. If you’re looking for a patient, loving, and devoted friend who will blossom beautifully in a supportive and caring home, Gem is waiting to meet you. With time, love, and consistency, this gentle girl will become a treasured member of your family, bringing warmth and happiness every day.

NAME: Maggie
TEXT: Meet Maggie 🐾 Maggie is a delightful lady with a heart as big as her smile! She’s a truly social soul who absolutely loves people, especially children, and has a gentle way with them that instantly wins hearts. Not only is she great with kids, but Maggie also adores other dogs and cats, making her a wonderful addition to any multi-pet household. She has a special knack for getting along beautifully with other greyhounds, so she’ll fit right in with a fellow pup or two. One of Maggie’s standout qualities is her love of adventure and travel. She’s a champ in the car, settling quickly and calmly once she’s found her stride, which means road trips or visits to new places are always stress-free with her by your side. Maggie’s personality shines through in her playful and friendly nature. She’s always ready for a game, a cuddle, or just hanging out and sharing the good vibes. Once she’s comfortable in her surroundings, she’s calm and content, making her a perfect companion for both active days and cozy evenings. If you’re looking for a loving, happy, and adaptable greyhound who’ll bring joy and companionship to your life, Maggie is the perfect match. She can’t wait to meet her forever family and start making wonderful memories together!

NAME: Snooty
TEXT: Snooty is a charming boy with a heart full of love and a tail that’s always wagging. Snooty walks beautifully on lead and loves getting out and about, making him the perfect company for an adventure or an afternoon stroll. Snooty is super affectionate and friendly and he absolutely adores pats and scratches! He’s also a social butterfly who has shown positive interactions with dogs of all sizes, so pending a meet and greet, may suit a home with a canine friend. If you’re looking for a loving companion who’s as gentle as he is joyful, Snooty is your guy. Apply now!

NAME: Sunny
TEXT: Hi, I'm Sunny! Like a perfect spring day, the sun is shining, and I promise to be a bright and happy presence in your life! I am a calm, loving boy. I am happy, easy going and engaging, quite charismatic if I do say so myself. I would love a fenced yard to call my own, so I can enjoy my sunbaking zoomies. Due to my charming nature I'd do well in a home with other dog/s big or small. I hope my gorgeous nature shines through the screen, and that you can't wait to meet me, because I am a polite and laid back boy who can't wait to meet you! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Tammy
TEXT: Tammy is a smart, curious girl who does excellent with training. She is affectionate, happy, and always looks to her handler for praise and recognition, making her a perfect match for someone who likes an engaged, trainable, and sweet best friend. She has learnt about stairs, and learning yes, toilet, touch and watch cues. She is calm, gentle and walks well on lead, and is an overall very polite girl. She is best described as "SUPER sweet"! Meet this gorgeous girl by applying! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Lonnie
TEXT: Hey, I'm Lonnie! With my big happy smile, I hope I catch your eye! I'm a friendly girl to people and dogs alike, making me a wonderful family pet. I walk perfectly on the lead, and I have a lovely gentle personality. I like car rides, adventures and having fun with my people. I would love a home who will show me all about the big wide world and include me in daily activities. I have a soft, gentle personality and would love to meet you! Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Hi, I'm angel, a gentle mannered quiet girl looking for a forever home. I'm middle aged, making me sweet and calm and ready to snooze by your side. I can take a little time to warm up but I promise to be your best friend once I get to know you. Another dog does give me some more confidence so maybe you have a confident doggie for me to be friends with? I'd love a courtyard or backyard to call my own, as I love being outside in the sunshine. Available in Northern Rivers.

NAME: Betsy
TEXT: Meet Betsy! Little Betsy is the life of the party! This small girl loves nothing more than playing with her toys and bringing a smile to everyone she meets. She’s always up for an adventure and enjoys going for a stroll where she can take her time and explore the environment to take in the world around her. Betsy is friendly and polite with medium to large dogs, but her favourite companions are people! She’s been making terrific progress in her training and is eager to keep learning. Betsy would thrive in a home with a backyard in a quieter area, where she's able to enjoy plenty of company throughout the day as she continues to learn how to relax on her own. Her excitable, goofy nature makes her best suited to a family with older children who can join in her fun, yet respect her space. She loves her toys and has a high food drive, making her training sessions an absolute ball. She has learnt "on your bed" and how to lay down and settle on her bed. If you’ve got space on your couch, Betsy just might be the perfect fit! Contact the team at the Western Sydney Adoption Centre to meet her.

NAME: Cobalt
TEXT: **Cobalt has spent time in a foster home, read below to see what his carers have said about his time during foster!** Cobalt foster update: "He is a very gentle, sweet boy that loves hugs, pats and praises. He isn't highly motivated with food, more on praises and pats! He loves playing with his squeaky toy and loves playing fetch. He is still yet to learn how to give the ball back though. He loves going for walks and knows how to communicate it to you by getting your attention and pointing his nose to his leash. He would prefer to have access to inside and outside the house during the day, especially when you're not home. He sleeps right throughout the night and snoozes most of the day. He has been polite with our free ranging pet chickens, provided that they are behind the fence. When we do let the chickens out, he is well behaved on his leash." Cobalt is a super affectionate and cuddly companion who can't wait to begin spending time with his new family. A home in a quiet area with a backyard would be most beneficial so he can have somewhere to run around and sunbake! Whether he's playing in the backyard or just enjoying a lazy afternoon, Cobalt brings joy wherever he goes!

NAME: Milo
TEXT: Meet Milo 🐾 Milo is a lovely girl with a heart full of affection and a playful spirit that shines brightest when she’s with her favourite toys. She absolutely loves playtime and will happily entertain herself (and you!) with her collection of fun chew toys and games. Milo would do best with a submissive doggo friend who understands her boundaries and lets her take the lead. She tends to resource guard her food at home, so a calm and confident companion who respects her space would be ideal. This gorgeous girl has a very high prey drive, meaning she’s intensely focused when it comes to small animals. However, she’s proven to be okay with dashy breeds like other greyhounds, so with the right introductions and management, she can live happily alongside certain dogs. Milo has experience living around children and a Rottweiler, but she’s best suited to an experienced owner who understands her unique needs and can provide consistent guidance, training, and patience. If you’re looking for a smart, affectionate, and playful girl who thrives with the right structure and company, Milo is ready to bring joy, love, and some spirited playtime into your home!

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Meet Tina 🐾 Tina is a beautiful girl with a gentle soul and a personality as soft as her fur. She’s the kind of greyhound who might take a little time to warm up — but when she does, get ready for some seriously sweet cuddles and affectionate moments that will melt your heart! This lovely lady would really thrive in a home with another calm, friendly dog to keep her company. Having a furry friend to lean on helps Tina feel confident and happy, and she’d love nothing more than to have a buddy to share her adventures (and naps) with. Tina is especially fond of medium to large-sized dogs — she knows exactly what kind of pals make the best cuddle buddies! . She would really benefit from sleeping in a crate as she’s spent most of her life sharing a kennel with another greyhound. Tina loves her daily walks and exploring the great outdoors, but don’t worry — she’s not looking for a marathon runner. A nice, moderate-paced stroll suits her just fine, making her perfect for someone who enjoys a balance between fresh air and cozy downtime. With her sweet, gentle nature, Tina is a quiet ray of sunshine who will bring calm, warmth, and lots of love to the right home. She might start out a bit shy, but give her time and patience, and she’ll bloom into a loyal and loving companion who can’t wait to share cuddles and calm moments with you. If you’re after a stunning, gentle greyhound who’s ready to warm your heart and your couch with her sweet personality, Tina is waiting to meet her perfect family!

NAME: Sooky
TEXT: Meet Sooky 🐾 Sooky is a beautiful girl with a soft heart and a gentle spirit. She’s the kind of girl who doesn’t ask for much — just a calm home, a comfy spot inside, and someone who understands her sensitive nature. Sooky can be a little unsure when left alone for long periods, so she'd do best in a home where she has access to the indoors during the day, especially if her humans are out. Having that safe, familiar space helps ease her anxiety and lets her settle in comfortably. She currently lives on a property with a cattle dog and gets along well, so she could definitely benefit from having another calm, furry companion to keep her company. Sooky is small dog workable, and with a slow and respectful introduction, she may also be cat workable — she’s happy to coexist and just vibe out with her friends. This lovely girl has no need for chaos — she’s all about the peaceful life. She enjoys a quiet day, a gentle stroll, and the comfort of knowing she’s not alone. Whether she’s lying in a sunny patch of grass or relaxing on the couch, Sooky brings a quiet calm wherever she goes. If you're looking for a sweet, sensitive greyhound who just wants a peaceful home, a bit of company, and a place to feel safe, Sooky might just be the perfect fit.

NAME: Austin
TEXT: Meet Austin 🐾 If you're looking for a greyhound with personality plus, say hello to Austin — a high-energy, super-friendly boy who lives life in the fast lane (especially when it comes to zoomies in the backyard!). Austin has the biggest personality — he’s outgoing, full of fun, and always ready to turn any moment into an adventure. Whether he's making new doggy friends, hanging out with the kids, or showing off his zoomie skills, Austin brings energy, joy, and a whole lot of love to every situation. This fun-loving guy would thrive in an active home that can match his zest for life. He’d do best with older children who can enjoy his playful spirit without being overwhelmed by his enthusiasm. He’s also small dog workable, and we think he’d really benefit from having a doggy friend to run around and share the fun with. Austin is the kind of greyhound who fills a home with laughter, playtime, and cuddles (once he's burned off some energy, of course!). He’s incredibly friendly with both dogs and children, and he's always looking for someone to hang out with, whether it’s for a walk, a game, or just some backyard fun. If your household is ready for a greyhound who’s all about big energy, big heart, and big love, then Austin is ready to zoom right into your life — and your heart.

NAME: Ponch
TEXT: Meet Ponch 🐾 Ponch is a stunning lady with a quiet confidence and a calm, independent spirit. She’s the perfect blend of self-assured and affectionate — the kind of greyhound who enjoys doing her own thing but will happily come over for a gentle cuddle or some quiet time with her people. Ponch doesn’t need to be the centre of attention to shine. She’s affectionate on her own terms, which makes those loving moments feel more special. She's a lovely, low-fuss companion who will be right there beside you — especially if there's a cozy couch involved. This beautiful girl is cat and dog workable, meaning with the right introductions and a bit of patience, she could happily settle into a multi-pet household. In fact, we think she’d thrive with some furry friends around to keep her company and share her chill vibe. Ponch is also a bit of a couch potato — she loves a good nap and has truly mastered the art of lounging. Whether it’s a lazy afternoon or a quiet evening in, Ponch will be right there relaxing with you, making every moment feel a little more peaceful. If you're looking for an independent yet loving greyhound who would flourish in a home with other pets and bring a gentle calmness to your life, Ponch could be your perfect match.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris 🐾 Looking for a big-hearted best mate with extra-long legs and even longer cuddle sessions? Say hello to Boris — a supersized sweetheart who’s equal parts lounge lizard and lovebug! The only way to describe him is…. A gentle giant. Boris is a big boy (and he knows it!), but don’t let his size fool you — he’s a total softie who lives for snuggles and affection. If there’s a comfy spot and a human nearby, Boris is already there, leaning in for pats and making himself right at home. He loves hanging out with his fellow greyhounds and is a bit of a social butterfly in the dog world. Whether it's chilling in the backyard or going for a casual group walk, Boris is all about the good vibes and friendly company. Car rides? Trailer trips? No worries! Boris is calm, cool, and collected on the move. He travels like a seasoned pro — just give him a spot to settle and he’s happy to watch the world go by (or take a nap en route to his next adventure). Boris would love a home where he can lounge around, share his oversized heart, and maybe steal a spot on the couch (or at least a corner!). If you’re after a chill, cuddly, and all-around lovely lad to complete your family — Boris is ready to roll right into your life and never look back.

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Meet Danny 🐕 Danny is a charming and affectionate boy with a big heart and a friendly soul. He absolutely adores other greyhounds and thrives in their company. Although he hasn’t been tested around smaller dogs yet, his gentle and calm nature suggests he could adapt well with the right introduction. Danny has lived happily with young children and has proven to be a patient and loving friend to the little ones in his life. He’s used to the hustle and bustle of a busy home and enjoys being part of a family environment where he can share lots of love and attention. One of Danny’s standout qualities is how beautifully he walks on the lead — calm, polite, and well-mannered, he makes every walk a pleasant experience. He’s also very trainable and responds well to crate training, which helps him settle and feel secure when needed. Danny would do best in a home that has a backyard or safe outdoor space where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some fresh air, and have the freedom to relax and play. He’s not just an energetic pup; he’s a true people-lover who thrives on companionship and bonds closely with his humans. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly, and devoted greyhound who will fit seamlessly into a loving home, Danny could be your perfect match. He’s ready to share his heart and make new memories with a family that can give him the care and affection he deserves.

NAME: Lawsie
TEXT: Meet Lawsie 🐾 Lawsie is a vibrant and confident boy who’s bursting with energy and enthusiasm for life! This lively boy loves nothing more than spending time with his fellow greyhounds — their company really makes him shine. With a slow and careful introduction, Lawsie can also learn to get along well with small dogs, though he’s better suited to a household that understands his playful and excitable nature. Lawsie thrives in a home with older children who can keep up with his high energy and enjoy joining in on his fun adventures. He’s happiest when he’s zooming around, chasing his favorite toys, and letting loose with the classic greyhound zoomies that will bring a smile to anyone’s face. His playful spirit and bright personality make him a true bundle of joy to be around. While Lawsie is friendly and outgoing, he is a bit stronger on the lead due to his excitement, so some patient lead training will help him focus and walk calmly by your side. This little guy is eager to learn and wants to impress his new family! If you’re looking for a confident, happy-go-lucky companion who will fill your home with energy and love, Lawsie could be the perfect match. He’s ready to bring endless fun and affection to a patient family who can match his pace and appreciate his wonderful personality.

NAME: Isla
TEXT: If you're looking for a simply ADORABLE senior girl, look no further than Isla. This gorgeous girl might be greying in the face but we know her to be a super adorable wiggly playful girl with a youthful side. She will play bow at you, do goofy zoomies, and we think it's so cute! Isla is super affectionate and will happily lie in your lap on the couch. She would suit apartment living with lift access. She doesn't mind seeing dogs on walks but would prefer not to share her home with one. Due to her sweet and loving nature, we think respectful kids would get along with her. Meet our special girl Isla at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Speedy
TEXT: Meet Speedy 🐕‍🦺 Speedy is a true friend to all dogs and thrives on socializing with his canine companions. He’s incredibly friendly and easy going, but when it comes to smaller pups, he appreciates those who are confident and respectful—he knows how to set boundaries without fuss. With the right doggy friends, Speedy blossoms into the perfect playmate and loyal buddy, making him an ideal addition to a multi-dog household where everyone gets along peacefully. Travel is no trouble for Speedy; in fact, he’s always eager to hop in the van and go on new adventures. Whether it’s a quick trip to the park, a visit to the vet, or a day out exploring, Speedy handles car rides like a seasoned pro. His calm demeanour makes traveling stress-free and enjoyable for everyone involved. On walks, Speedy is a dream. He walks beautifully on the lead, matching your pace with effortless grace and a happy tail wag. His cruisy personality shines through every step, making your daily strolls a pleasure rather than a chore. Beyond his sociable nature with dogs and his love for travel, Speedy has a wonderfully happy and relaxed attitude towards life. He’s content to chill at home, soak up some sun, or simply be near his humans, always with a calm, gentle presence that brings peace to any household. If you’re looking for a well-mannered, sociable, and super laid-back companion who loves life, good company, and peaceful adventures, Speedy is the one to meet. With his loving nature and easy going spirit, he’s ready to cruise his way into your heart and home.

NAME: Johnno
TEXT: Meet Johnno 🐾 If you’re after a four-legged friend who’s basically the life of the dog park, meet Johnno! This easy going greyhound is the friendliest fellow around, with a heart big enough to love every dog he meets—no matter their breed, size, or background. From tiny terriers to giant retrievers, Johnno’s your go-to guy for making furry friends everywhere he goes. Johnno is polite, well-mannered, and knows how to keep things chill. He’s got a laid-back vibe that’s infectious, and new people? New places? No problem at all! He strolls into new situations with a wagging tail and a big, confident smile, showing zero stress and 100% charm. Whether it’s a bustling park or a quiet street, Johnno takes it all in stride like the cool, confident companion he is. Travel? Bring it on! Johnno is a seasoned pro in the car—no fuss, no drama—just happy to hop in and enjoy the ride. Road trips, vet visits, or weekend getaways, he’s your easy-to-travel-with buddy who’s always ready for the next adventure. With Johnno, you get a loving, social butterfly who thrives on meeting new friends, both two-legged and four-legged. He’s the kind of dog who will greet everyone politely but happily, making friends everywhere he goes without a hint of stress or worry. If you want a calm, friendly, and adaptable companion with a big heart and an even bigger smile, Johnno is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Meet Millie 🌿 Millie is a lovely greyhound with a gentle spirit who tends to be a little nervous in new situations. She needs some encouragement and lots of patience as she learns to feel safe and comfortable in her new surroundings. With the right support, Millie will blossom into a loving and devoted companion. Because Millie is shy, she would benefit hugely from foster care, where she can receive one-on-one attention and gentle guidance during her initial settling-in phase. A quiet, calm household would be the perfect environment for her to grow in confidence without feeling overwhelmed. Millie is good with cats and would happily share her home with them. When it comes to other dogs, she’ll need a slow and careful introduction to build trust and feel at ease. With time and gentle encouragement, she can learn to enjoy canine company. This special girl is looking for someone with a kind heart who understands that patience and love are the keys to helping her settle in and feel truly at home. If you have a calm space and the time to nurture Millie’s confidence, she could be the perfect addition to your life.

NAME: Dancer
TEXT: Meet Dancer 💃 Dancer is a beautiful girl with a quiet charm and a soul full of tenderness. A little shy at first, she takes her time to get comfortable in new surroundings—but once she gets to know you, she reveals the sweetest, most affectionate side of herself. She loves companionship but prefers to make the first move. Once she feels safe, she’ll come to you for affection. Dancer is looking for a calm, peaceful home where she can truly relax and come into her own. A quieter household, free from too much hustle and bustle, would suit her best—somewhere she can settle at her own pace and feel secure. She’d do well with older, respectful children who can give her the gentle space she needs to flourish. She’s wonderfully polite with other animals and gets along well with both dogs and cats. Whether she joins a home with other calm pets or becomes your one and only, she’ll be a loyal and loving presence once she finds her confidence. This lovely girl isn’t looking for loud excitement or constant attention—just a safe place, kind people, and the chance to build a bond that runs deep. With a little time, a lot of love, and plenty of patience, Dancer will reward you with quiet loyalty and a heart full of trust. Dancer is ready to find her soft place to land.

NAME: Dasha
TEXT: Meet Dasha – the darling girl with a playful streak! Dasha is a loving, calm, and confident girl who brings just the right mix of fun and relaxation. She enjoys her morning zoomie, a walk during the day, and another burst of play in the evening – the rest of the time, she’s more than happy to lounge on the couch. She's a cuddly teddy bear! She’s great with little dogs, friendly with other greys, and would suit a family with kids 10+ or a companion home. Dasha is housetrained (she’ll let you know when she needs to go out!) and settles well on her own once comfortable. This chatty girl does have one funny quirk – a love for toilet paper – so keep your bathroom doors closed! With her gentle nature and sweet personality, Dasha will make a wonderful family pet or loving companion.💘 *Come meet Dasha at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Elsa
TEXT: Look at my adorable puppy dog eyes...now click here to learn more about me! I am a happy, bright girl who is on the more active and confident side. I am social with other greyhounds and enjoy attention, pats and all the fuss you have to give me. My favourite treat is Mcdonalds ice cream, and I'm super gentle around children, too! I'd love a backyard to romp around in with the family kids and lots of fun toys to keep me occupied! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Suzie
TEXT: If you're looking for a beautiful blue girl, who is soft natured, middle aged and laid back - click here! Suzie would be a great addition to a home with another greyhound as she has lived along side one. She is gentle, social, confident and laid back. She would do best with a small outdoor area to call her own (courtyard/townhouse) and would enjoy laid back daily walkies. She promises to walk perfectly on lead for you. Suzie is a sweet girl who can't wait to meet you at the Western Sydney Londonderry adoption centre.

NAME: Cashew
TEXT: Cashew is a small, smart, vibrant and cheerful girl. She has an energetic side and would do best with an active and stimulating life. A home with a backyard to call her own would suit her best, so she can zoom and play fetch. She is pretty independent and has shown to settle and entertain herself with food puzzles, snuffle mats or her toys! A structured routine and someone who enjoys the company of a confident, engaged dog, would be the best fit. Someone who enjoys dog training and living a fun, full life, would love having Cashew by their side. Cashew has some experience around older children and would suit living in a family with kids, as she would keep the kids entertained and would love to be part of your daily activities. This gorgeous girl is super friendly, active and curious. She loves to run and play, chase balls and live a fun, full life, but her most favourite thing to do is play fetch - it is so much fun and an absolute delight watching her catch balls or toys in mid-air then throwing them back at you so she can go again! This adorable little girl can be adopted at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a happy, social guy who’s always ready to make new friends and find a place to call home! He’s full of charm, loves his treats and meeting new humans while hes out and about. Ace has shown to walk beautifully on lead and would be a great addition to a home with a medium to large dog who enjoys some company, pending a meet and greet. His friendly nature and love of being part of the action make him a joy to have around. If you're after a loyal mate with a sweet personality and a love for life, Ace might just be your perfect match! Meet Ace at Western Sydney.

NAME: Richard
TEXT: Richard is a charming greyhound, full of curiosity and a calm, friendly nature. He’s great on the lead and loves meeting new people, making him a wonderful companion for walks and outings. Having grown up with his greyhound pals, Richard would be happy in a home with another medium to large dog who can match his easygoing spirit, pending a meet and greet. So if you’re looking for a loyal friend to share adventures with, Richard is your guy! Come meet Richard at Western Sydney and see if he’s the perfect fit for your family.

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: This sweet girl has entered her golden years and is ready to find her forever home! Georgia warms up to new people in no time and loves affection, often leaning in for more pats and scratches behind the ear (an easy way to win her over!). Georgia would prefer a quieter home with a laid back life style so she can spend her days upside down on a couch or catching rays in the yard. A home with adults or older children would also best suit Georgia. She gets a long well with other Greyhounds so pending a meet and greet, could suit a home with another medium to large canine friend. Meet Georgia at Western Sydney!

NAME: Wilson
TEXT: Hi, I'm Wilson, a gorgeous blue boy looking to find my forever home - maybe it's you? I love travelling and going on adventures, and I'm good with other dogs, too. I'm a very happy guy who is keen to interact with who ever wants to give me a pat. I'd love a backyard to call my own, some kids to keep me entertained and active, and would happily co exist with your current dog/s! Meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jerry
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jerry! I love kids aged 2 up and have lots of experience with them, I'm gentle and love the attention if I'm honest! I'm overall laid back & gentle, and have done all sorts of things to get ready to be your perfect pet, including meeting a staghound & Great Dane x. I'm super easy on lead, not an active dog but loves attention when seeing visitors, and would love to get out and have a play with you in the yard during the day! I like travelling in cars and vans, easy to walk on the lead and love playing with squeaky toys. I could live with other dogs male or female, and I'm ready to show off my happy go lucky energy! Adopt me from the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Say hello to Sally—the life of the party and a greyhound full of bounce, joy, and endless fun! This playful girl loves her toys, lives for a good zoomie session, and thrives in an environment where she can stretch her long legs and let loose. Sally would love a home with a spacious yard and an active lifestyle to match her energy. She isn’t suited to homes with small animals but she’s a great match for other greyhounds or larger breeds who enjoy a good play session, pending a successful meet and greet. Sally is also a total sweetheart with people and doesn’t hold back on affection. Whether it’s leaning into a cuddle, joining in on family activities, or bringing her toy over for a game, she makes every moment fun and full of love. If you're looking for a lively, loving companion who will keep you smiling and moving, Sally might just be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Snookie
TEXT: *Snookie is in a foster care apartment home - reach out to the team to meet her!* Her foster carers say "Snookie would be the perfect pet for someone looking for a companion dog who is low maintenance and prefers a quiet lifestyle." Foster Update: "Snookie has really come out of her shell the past few weeks. She is very independent, and can spend hours alone with no issues at all. However she can also be really cuddly (when she feels like it), she also loves greeting us when we get up in the morning and when we come home, and lying next to us on the bed or the lounge. She loves going for walks, though be prepared for walks to take twice as long as usual as she thoroughly investigates everything in sight. She loves to meet other dogs, and isn’t afraid of them at all even if they bark at her. She is very calm and always wants to say hello. She is very interested in cats as well and could potentially be cat safe. She is very gentle (we tested her with my 1 year old nephew) but will try to walk away if there is a small child around. She is very happy to be in an apartment as long as she can have her own space. Also no signs of sleep startle or resource guarding at all." Sweet little Snookie can be adopted via appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Steve
TEXT: Meet Happy Handsome Steve! He's a friendly, loving boy who loves to lie around in the sun or on the lounge, pretty docile but loves a walk and a play in the yard. He has a bit of a limp from a previous injury but he's happy to run around, not in pain, and isn't high energy. Steve loves to sleep! He has spent time with Jack Russells, was ok around free range chickens and a sheep in the yard next door, also lived with another greyhound, not worried about which bed he sleeps on, he will snooze anywhere! Loves his shell pool to cool off in summer. Steve would make a lovey pet or companion, easy to care for and just likes a bit of attention, pats, somewhere to snooze and someone to love. Fine for workers. Aww, look at those soulful eyes, pick me!💙 *Come meet Steve at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a sweet and gentle soul who’s looking for a calm, loving home where she can settle in at her own pace. She can be a little shy to start, but with patience and kindness, she’ll begin to show you just how affectionate and loving she truly is. Jill would be best suited to a quieter lifestyle, where she can feel safe, secure, and take things one step at a time. With slow and careful introductions, she could potentially be okay around smaller dogs, especially those who are calm and respectful. If you’re looking for a soft-natured companion who will quietly steal your heart, Jill might be the perfect match.

NAME: Rambo
TEXT: Rambo has enjoyed his stint in foster care, his favourite hobbies include napping on the floor, asking for cuddles (and cheese), and of course exploring the neighbourhood on his daily walks. Having lived in a foster care home, he now has his ‘stairs license’ and can confidently climb several floors. Rambo has a lot of love to give, and would therefore thrive in a calm environment. While he’s very obedient and respectful, Rambo is still working on his skills of independence and improving his confidence when being left alone for longer periods of time. He would enjoy a home with a laid back type of life. Known to roach and chill out, Rambo would be an amazing addition for a laid back couple, retirees due to his gentle nature, or a work from home lifestyle, as long as he gets a couple of short toilet walks around the block. Rambo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Valavera
TEXT: Meet Valavera 🌟 Say hello to Valavera, a fun-loving and affectionate girl who’s ready to bring joy to any household! Valavera is a social butterfly who absolutely adores both dogs and cats, making her a wonderful fit for multi-pet homes. She’s also fantastic with children, showing endless patience and a playful spirit that kids will love. Valavera has the perfect balance of energy and chill. She enjoys bursts of playful zoomies and fun, then happily settles down for some well-deserved cuddles and relaxation. This lively yet calm mix makes her a great companion for families, couples, or individuals. She’d thrive best in a home where someone is around part-time or working from home, so she can get plenty of playtime and affection throughout the day. Valavera simply loves her people and is happiest when she’s close by, ready to share both fun and snuggles. If you’re looking for a loving, adaptable, and playful greyhound who will brighten your days with her energy and warm your heart with her cuddles, Valavera is the one for you!

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Meet Bob 🐾 Introducing Bob, a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, easy-going nature. Bob is the kind of companion who doesn’t need much – just a quiet home, some treats, and a loving human (or two) to call his own. Bob is friendly with other dogs, cat-tolerant, and would do well in a home with older, respectful children. His gentle demeanour and soft, soulful eyes make him a peaceful presence, and he’s happiest when surrounded by the people he loves. This sweet boy has so much affection to give and loves nothing more than being close to his human family. He’s more than happy to chill out for most of the day, watching the world go by from a comfy spot in the house, or curling up next to you for some quiet company. Bob isn’t looking for adventure – just a calm, loving home where he can feel safe, relaxed, and cherished. If you’re after a loyal companion who will bring peace, love, and gentle tail wags into your life, Bob might just be the perfect match. He’s ready to settle down and soak up all the love his forever family has to offer – could that be you?

NAME: Nicko
TEXT: Meet Nicko 💤 🐾 Looking for a calm, low-maintenance companion to match your relaxed lifestyle? Nicko might be your perfect match. This laid-back greyhound boy is the definition of cool, calm, and collected. With his gentle nature and love for the quiet life, Nicko would thrive in a peaceful home with someone who enjoys a slower pace and values the joy of simple companionship. Nicko is incredibly relaxed around other dogs and enjoys the company of canine friends. He’s also shown a calm curiosity around children, making him a lovely addition to a home with respectful kids who understand his mellow vibe. And here's a bonus – Nicko could live with a cat! With a careful and slow introduction, he may adapt well to a feline housemate, making him a rare gem in the greyhound world. Nicko isn't the type to demand constant attention or high-energy adventures – a comfy bed, a few gentle walks, and the quiet presence of his human(s) is all he needs to be content. He’s ideal for someone who works from home, is retired, or simply prefers the comfort of a more peaceful routine. If you’re ready to share your life with a sweet, chilled-out greyhound who just wants to be near you and enjoy the calm moments, Nicko is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Meet Emma 🐾 Say hello to Emma, a gentle, affectionate, and quietly charming greyhound with a heart full of love. With her graceful presence and calm nature, Emma is the kind of dog who quickly becomes the heart of any home. She loves nothing more than spending time with her people – whether that’s relaxing on the couch, following you around the house, or just being nearby while you work or unwind. Emma walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys her daily strolls, especially when she gets to catch up with her greyhound friends. She’s well-mannered around other medium to large dogs and has a calm, friendly way about her that makes her easy to get along with. Emma is also great with children and would be a wonderful companion for a family or a household with visiting grandkids. While she’s happy to snooze the day away in true greyhound fashion, Emma does best when she has company. She would thrive in a home where someone is around most of the time – whether you work part-time or from home, Emma will be your loyal and loving sidekick. If you’re looking for a gentle soul with lots of love to give, Emma is ready to steal your heart and become your new best friend.

NAME: Kenzie
TEXT: Meet Kenzie 🐾 Kenzie is a sweet and gentle girl with a heart full of love, though she’s a bit on the timid side. Because of her shy nature, she would do best in a calm, quiet home with older kids who understand and respect her gentle spirit. Kenzie isn’t one to jump into new situations quickly, but once she feels safe, her true personality begins to shine. She absolutely adores playing with her cuddly toy—watching her wag her happy tail as she tosses it around is sure to bring a smile to your face! Kenzie is a social little lady too; she gets along wonderfully with both cats and other dogs, making her a perfect fit for a multi-pet household. While she may start off shy, she always musters the courage to come say hi and make a sweet connection. Kenzie is patiently waiting for her forever family, where she can blossom and grow in confidence. With a little time, patience, and lots of love, she’ll become the loyal and affectionate companion you’ve been dreaming of.
