If you’re looking for a loving, gentle soul to share your life with, Kenzie could be your perfect match!

NAME: Tarnie
TEXT: Meet Tarnie! 🐾 Tarnie is a stunning girl with a heart as big as her soulful eyes. She’s known for her super sweet nature and gentle demeanour, making her an absolute delight to be around. Tarnie is wonderfully friendly with both cats and dogs, so she’s a great fit for homes with other furry family members. One of Tarnie’s greatest loves is children—she’s happy to play and interact with little ones, showing patience and kindness that makes her a wonderful companion for families. At the same time, Tarnie knows how to take things at her own pace and enjoy some quiet, independent time whenever she feels like it. She’s a smart girl who walks beautifully on the lead, turning every walk into a relaxing and enjoyable adventure for her and her humans. Whether it’s playtime, cuddle time, or just hanging out, Tarnie adapts easily and would suit a variety of households, from busy family homes to quieter ones. If you’re looking for a loving, gentle, and easy-going friend who will bring warmth and happiness into your life, Tarnie could be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Riley
TEXT: Meet Riley 🐾 Say hello to Riley, a gorgeous girl with a heart as big as her smile! Bursting with confidence and a zest for life, Riley is the kind of dog who adapts beautifully to just about any home – whether it’s a bustling family household or a quieter space with a solo human or two. Riley is the full package: cat-friendly, dog-friendly, and full of that easy-going greyhound grace we all adore. She's relaxed at home, happy to lounge around and soak up the love, but don’t let her chill side fool you – Riley absolutely loves to explore! Whether it's a walk through the neighbourhood or a new scent trail in the backyard, this girl is always ready for a little adventure. With her naturally happy nature and calm confidence, Riley would thrive in most households. She’s the kind of companion who will slot right into your routine, shower you with affection, and make every day a little brighter. Looking for a sweet, social, and steady best friend? Riley might just be your perfect match. 💕

NAME: Godfrey
TEXT: Meet Godfrey 🐾💙 Say hello to Godfrey, the most distinguished gentleman in the greyhound world! With his irresistibly cute Roman nose and soulful eyes, Godfrey is a total heart-stealer who’s ready to find his forever couch – ideally one he can share with a canine companion. This easy-going boy has truly mastered the art of balance: he’s just as happy chilling at home with his humans as he is trotting around the neighbourhood, taking in all the sights and smells. A total dream on the lead, Godfrey walks loosely and politely, making strolls a breeze. He’s super social, loves a good cuddle, and would thrive in a home with another calm, friendly dog to pal around with. Godfrey’s gentle nature and laid-back vibe make him the perfect addition to a relaxed, loving household. If you’re after a loyal, low-maintenance best friend who brings charm, cuddles, and a touch of Roman elegance to your life, Godfrey might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Meet Charlie! 🐾🌟 Charlie is a gentle, slightly reserved greyhound who quickly warms up once he feels settled and safe. This calm and affectionate boy enjoys exploring the world through his nose, taking in all the smells and sights on his sniffing adventures. Charlie thrives on companionship and would be happiest in a home where he can be part of the family’s daily life. He’s great with other dogs and cats, making him an ideal addition to a multi-pet household. Charlie’s easy-going nature means he adapts well to new environments, especially with a little patience and time to adjust. Charlie would do best in a home where he isn’t left alone for long periods. He loves having company, whether that’s a family with kids to keep him entertained or someone who works from home or part-time, so he never feels lonely. If you’re looking for a sweet, adaptable companion who loves to explore and enjoys the company of both humans and other pets, Charlie is ready to be your loyal friend. Charlie would be most suited to: A multi-pet household with dogs and/or cats A family environment with children who can provide gentle companionship A home where someone is present part-time or works from home An owner or family willing to give him time and patience to settle in A calm and loving environment where he can enjoy daily sniffing adventures and relaxed walks If Charlie sounds like your perfect match, do not hesitate to come and meet him!

NAME: Scarlette
TEXT: Meet Scarlett!🐾❤️ Scarlett is a joyful girl with a bright and confident personality that lights up any room she enters. She’s a social sweetheart who gets along wonderfully with all dogs and even likes cats, making her a fantastic fit for a multi-pet household. This happy girl would thrive in a loving family environment where she can enjoy plenty of company and affection. Scarlett’s confident nature means she’s comfortable exploring new places and meeting new friends, whether they have two legs or four. While Scarlett is a great walker overall, she could benefit from a bit of training on the lead to help her become an even better walking companion. With some patience and positive reinforcement, she’ll master those walks in no time! If you’re looking for a cheerful, adaptable greyhound who’ll bring joy and companionship to your family, Scarlett might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris🐾🌟 Boris is a sweet-natured boy with a calm heart and a curious spirit. He loves the company of other dogs, especially those larger in size, and enjoys the comfort and companionship of furry friends by his side. While Boris has a wonderfully gentle personality, he thrives best in an active lifestyle that keeps his mind and body engaged. He benefits from plenty of enrichment—whether that’s long walks, sniffing new trails, or interactive toys to keep him stimulated. Boris may take a little longer to settle into a new home, as he adjusts carefully to his surroundings. But once he feels comfortable, he truly blossoms into a confident and happy companion who loves to explore and soak up every moment of life. Because of his settling-in time and enrichment needs, an experienced greyhound owner may be preferred to help Boris thrive in his new environment. If you’re ready to welcome a patient, loving greyhound who will flourish with your time, attention, and active spirit, Boris could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Archie
TEXT: Meet Archie 🐾 ✨ Archie is a truly wonderful boy with a heart full of social spirit and a calm, confident nature. He absolutely adores spending time with other greyhounds and is happiest when he has a canine buddy by his side. Archie is great with medium to large dogs and fits perfectly into a multi-dog home where he can enjoy plenty of furry company. But it’s not just other dogs that Archie loves — he’s incredibly social and affectionate with people too! Archie thrives on human interaction and is always eager to make new friends, whether it’s a quick pat or some relaxed downtime together. His easy-going temperament means he’s not phased by much — busy environments, new places, or changes in routine don’t rattle this laid-back boy. Archie would do well in a home with older children who understand how to respect boundaries and enjoy gentle play. His calm and steady demeanour makes him a wonderful companion for families, singles, or anyone looking for a loyal, loving dog who’s ready to be part of the family. If you want a confident, friendly, and adaptable greyhound who gets along with both dogs and humans alike, Archie is the perfect match!

NAME: Stoker
TEXT: Looking for a Greyhound full of charm, confidence, and a love for affection? Meet Stoker! Stoker is a friendly girl who loves all the humans she's met while she's out and about! She absolutely adores pats and is super affectionate. Whether it's a quiet evening snoozing or a stroll around the block, she’s happy just being by your side. Stoker wouldn't mind sharing her new home with another medium to large dog, and she might even be happy with a smaller canine companion, pending a meet and greet. Stoker could be the perfect addition to your family! Meet her at Western Sydney.

NAME: Dream
TEXT: Meet Dream 🐾 Dream is a stunning girl with a heart as big as her beautiful smile. She’s a social butterfly who loves making friends and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all sizes—small, medium, or large. Dream is relaxed around cats and tends to happily ignore them, making her a fantastic fit for multi-pet households. She adores children and would flourish in a family environment where she can share her gentle, loving nature. This sweet girl has so much love to give and truly enjoys receiving lots of cuddles and pats. Dream thrives on affection and companionship and is happiest when she’s surrounded by people who appreciate her calm and affectionate spirit. Dream would be well suited to households that: · Have multiple pets, including dogs and cats · Include children of all ages · Prefer a friendly, social dog who enjoys company · Can provide plenty of cuddles, pats, and love If you’re looking for a loving, happy greyhound to bring warmth and joy into your home, Dream is ready to become your new best friend.

NAME: Mouse
TEXT: Meet Mouse 🐾 Mouse is a lovely, older girl with a calm and easy-going nature that makes her truly special. Despite being a mature lady, she still enjoys her daily activities and remains active and lively in her own gentle way. She’s incredibly friendly and gets along beautifully with other dogs—especially her greyhound pals—and is also cat-friendly, making her a wonderful addition to a multi-pet household. Mouse would do best in a low-key, peaceful home where she can relax and enjoy a steady routine. She would suit families with children who understand and appreciate her laid-back, loving temperament. With her sweet, mellow personality and affectionate spirit, Mouse is ready to share her calm companionship and gentle love with a forever family who will cherish her for the wonderful old girl she is.

NAME: Cuddles
TEXT: Cuddles is a very affectionate and social girl, she gets on with everyone she meets and would make a great companion. She is great on the lead and very confident and content by nature. She would suit almost any environment given how laid back and confident she is.

NAME: Kingsley
TEXT: King is a wonderful boy who likes to chase after toys and play. He has great recall and comes when called. He is a great companion and very affectionate. He has been living around a mixture of native and domestic animals.

NAME: Jason
TEXT: Meet Jason, a sweet guy with lots of personality, ready to find a place to call home! A home with a backyard or courtyard would best suit Jason, so he can do his zoomies or have a snooze in the sun. He can be a little shy at first but with a few scratches behind the ear and a couple treats, you'll win him over in no time! A home with adults or older children would be best for this guy, to help ease him into pet life. Jason gets along well with his Greyhound mates, so a home with another medium to large dog could work for him, pending a meet and greet. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Val
TEXT: Val is a cuddly and affectionate softie. He will love to be around you when your home and play with toys and love going for walks with you. He would make an excellent addition to the family.

NAME: Rosita
TEXT: Meet Rosita! Rosita is a gorgeous girl with a heart as big as her beautiful smile. She’s an incredibly happy and sociable soul who thrives on being part of the action. Whether it’s greeting new friends or joining in family activities, Rosita’s enthusiasm and friendly nature make her a joy to be around. She absolutely loves saying hello to everyone she meets — from little kids to fellow dogs and even cats! Rosita’s easy going and gentle temperament means she’s great with all sorts of household members. She’s been living harmoniously with cats and other dogs, and her patience and kindness around children make her a fantastic choice for families of all shapes and sizes. She’s also confident and has successfully managed a couple of stairs, showing her adaptability and eagerness to learn. One of Rosita’s standout qualities is how beautifully she walks on the leash. Calm, focused, and responsive, she makes daily walks a true pleasure. Whether you’re out for a gentle stroll or a bit more active adventure, Rosita is happy to keep pace and explore alongside you. All in all, Rosita would suit most households—whether you’re looking for a loving companion in a bustling family home or a calm presence in a quieter environment. She’s ready to bring joy, warmth, and plenty of tail wags to her forever family. Could that be with you?

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rusty is a cute, snuggly guy who loves nothing more than leaning in for pats and cuddles. Food is definitely one of his favourite things, you’ll win his heart with treats in no time! He can be a little shy at first but with some time to settle him, Rusty will show you just how affectionate he is. Rusty would suit a home with adults or older children to help ease him into pet life. He also doesnt mind sharing his new space with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who’s ready to share snuggles and good times, Rusty might just be the perfect match! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tito
TEXT: If you're after a happy, friendly greyhound with a love for life, Tito is your guy! This cheerful boy is bursting with personality and with treats, toys and some love, his tail will always be wagging. Tito loves engaging with the new people he meets while he's out and about and wouldn't mind a home with older kids to match his playful spirit. He’d do best in a home with a backyard where he can have a play, do some zoomies or catch some rays ☀️ Tito may suit a home with another medium to large dog, pending a meet and greet to make sure it's the right fit for everyone! He’s also a star in the crate, happily munching on treats and chilling out. If you're ready for a life full of joy, play, and tail wags, Tito is the guy for you. Come and meet him at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jitter
TEXT: Meet Jitter 🌸 Say hello to Jitter, a beautiful senior lady with the softest eyes and the gentlest soul. She’s in her golden years and is now searching for the perfect place to enjoy the peaceful, loving retirement she so deeply deserves. Jitter is the definition of easy-going. She’s friendly, affectionate, and content to go with the flow. She’s fantastic with other dogs – big and small – and is also completely cat-friendly, making her a great fit for multi-pet homes. She’s also happy to share her space with children, as long as they’re the calm, gentle type who understand her love for quiet companionship. While Jitter enjoys affection – especially a soft pat and a warm cuddle – she’s also totally fine doing her own thing. She’s independent in the best way, happy to potter around the house or snooze in a comfy spot nearby while you go about your day. She doesn’t demand attention, but she’ll always be ready for a cuddle when you are. Jitter would thrive in a calm, relaxed household where she can enjoy the simple pleasures: soft beds, gentle hands, a quiet garden or sunny windowsill, and the company of people and pets who appreciate her peaceful energy. She’s not the type to bounce around or seek adventure – instead, she’s looking for a home filled with comfort, love, and understanding. Jitter is a low-maintenance, high-love kind of girl who will bring calm, comfort, and quiet joy to the right home. Let her spend her golden years knowing she’s truly loved.

NAME: Sharna
TEXT: I'm in foster care! Foster Update: "Her personality is really coming through now. She’s very confident, a little bit cheeky but super sweet. She seems to cope fine with being left for long periods. Some days I’ve had work and then had to go straight to sport and she’s hasn’t had any toileting accidents or any property damage. I’ve still not heard her bark (maybe the odd cry) so she’s been great for condensed living situations. No separation anxiety. She is very gentle and submissive with humans. She’s done well with me and my partner giving her hugs and kisses, she’s been nothing but loving and affectionate in response. She’s not a fussy dog and will pretty much lay anywhere and eat anything, although she LOVES having a nuzzle/snuggle on a couch. It’s still early to say, but she would do well in a home where someone that’s going to talk to her and include her. She makes amazing eye contact and adores being with her people. She’s a special doggy and it just needs to be someone that can see and appreciate her!" Hi, I'm Sharna. I'm a friendly, happy girl who can't wait to meet you. I love my training and will do anything for a treat. I would be happy living along side another Medium-Large doggie pal pending a meet and greet, and would be happy to live with calm sensible children, too! I have spent time in the office and have learnt toilet training and don't mind if you pop out every now and then. If you have a house with a backyard I'd be suitable for full time hours as I love to sunbake, snooze and get a quick zoomie out! Come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Adal
TEXT: Adal – A Big Hunk of Love! Adal is the sweetest, affectionate boy with a big heart and just as much love to give. He’s great with all people, always happy to see you, excitable at times and loves showering you with kisses. This easy-going lad enjoys his walks, car rides, playtime with his toys, and hanging out with his greyhound friends, as well as playing with the resident Whippet and Jack Russell. Adal isn’t a fan of storms, but he handles them well by quietly retreating to his safe spot inside on his bed or in a kennel in the garage until the weather passes. He’s not vocal, destructive, or escape-prone—he just likes to hunker down until it’s over. With his lovely nature, happy personality, and endless love to share, Adal will make a wonderful companion, especially if someone is home or close by if a storm is coming, and can be on his own or with another dog to play with. 💙 *Come meet Adal at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is the sweetest boy a heart full of love and legs built for adventure. This playful boy is looking for his forever home where he can shine as either your one-and-only or alongside another medium to large dog who matches his energy and style. 🐾 Personality & Temperament: Playful & affectionate – Jimmy loves to play and thrives on human interaction. Walk enthusiast – Walks are his favorite part of the day, and he’ll happily trot beside you rain or shine. Kid-friendly – Best suited to homes with older children who understand gentle dog manners. 🏡 Ideal Home: Jimmy would do best in a home where he’s either the only pet or paired with another dog of similar size. He’s not suited to living with small dogs or cats, but he’s got plenty of love to give to his human family.

NAME: Mindy
TEXT: Mindy is a little shy at first, but with a chance to warm up, she'll be showing you her goofy side in no time! Full time or part time workers may work for Mindy, she will just need a chance to build up to longer hours alone. Mindy would best suit a quiet home, with adults or older children to ease her into pet life. Although Mindy has been appropriate during her interactions with other dogs of all sizes, she would prefer to be the only dog in her new home, so she can have all the love to herself. Mindy loves a treat and has proven to be a real smarty pants, learning "down", "touch" and "shake" on cue! She has shown to settle well when left alone and while indoors, but would prefer a home with a yard or courtyard to have a play or a snooze. Come down and meet Mindy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Fatty Nova
TEXT: Nova is a happy girl who likes children. She can get a little excited to start so good supervision is a must. Nova has been around small dogs, she was polite and playful and would suit a calm small short haired dog or medium to large breed friend Nova would love a family that she can curl up with on the couch and teach her to play ball Nova has spent a small amount of time in the house and adjusted well and is looking forward to finding her own home

NAME: Zara
TEXT: Zara is a chilled and easy going girl Zara would like a quiet home where she can chill with her family and perhaps go on a short walk every few days Zara has been living in a home and is quiet and easy to live with Zara has been socialised with small dogs and would be fine with a relaxed quiet small friend

NAME: Tippy
TEXT: Tippy loves people and would love a family who will spend time playign with her Tippy loves to chase the ball and will quickly learn to bring it back. Tippy likes all sorts of toys not just balls Tippy has met small dogs and was very well mannered Tippy is chilled and easy going as well as playful

NAME: Ricky
TEXT: Ricky is a playful exuberant boy who would benefit from an active family He would loves some teenage mates to hang with Loves to play ball Has met small dogs and was well mannered so would suit a home with a confident small dog Very clean and tidy in his kennel

NAME: Tago
TEXT: Tago is calm and gentle Tago has met and socialised with multiple breeds of dogs and is happy to interact but likes to just do his own thing Tago is a clean and quiet boy Tago has met a cat, but was too busy looking at his own reflection in the mirror to be bothered by her

NAME: Bingo
TEXT: With Bingo, you'll always be a winner! Meet Bingo, a confident, lovable guy, looking for a place to call home. He is super confident and loves to learn (he'll do anything for a treat). Bingo has been great with interactions with his greyhound mates so could suit a home with another medium to large breed companion, pending a meet and greet. Bingo has shown to do well indoors so a unit or townhouse setting could be where he finds his new home, he may just need some time to settle into his new life and routine. He has also demonstrated confidence on our training staircase but would need some supporting guidance from his new family to tackle more challenging flights. This should be a breeze given his love for treats and praise. Shout BINGO if you think he's the one!

NAME: Azzie
TEXT: Great with young children. Happy go lucky guy. Calm, friendly & sweet natured. Good with smaller breeds of dogs. A quieter lifestyle would be best. If you might consider welcoming two greyhounds into your home, Azi’s brother Arrie is also searching for his forever home :)

NAME: Tess
TEXT: Tess is a little angel with a beautiful, gentle nature. She’s a quiet girl who will need a bit of time to settle in at her own pace, but once she feels safe and comfortable, she’ll become your loyal shadow and best friend. Tess could benefit from having a calm canine companion, but she’d prefer a relaxed dog rather than one with intense energy. Her ideal home is a quiet one, where she can truly relax and feel at ease. Tess loves nothing more than curling up on the lounge for a cuddle. While she enjoys her walks, she can get a little excited and may need some gentle guidance on the lead as she continues to learn. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, Tess will blossom into the most devoted and affectionate companion. Tess is food motivated, so will be easy to train! She has slept on a bed with her foster carer and has shown no signs of sleep startle.

NAME: Bossy
TEXT: Bossy has spent some time in a home! See what they have to say below! "Having previously owned and fostered greyhounds. I can honestly say that Bossy is by far the most gentle and happy go lucky boy. Bossy is timid at first but I promise after a good couple of days, he easily becomes your little helper (following you to the bathroom & kitchen) and becomes a part of the furniture - lazing about beside you. Bossy is cheeky at times however learns extraordinary quickly and will cease any naughtiness immediately if you ask politely in a mild mannered tone. He is sometimes unsure on the lead, which is to be expected: scared of new people & unfamiliar noises, he seems fine getting up and close to a variety of dogs whilst directly by my side but he does seem to have a bit of a flight response with human beings. However over the past week and a half, he has proven he is extremely trainable. He just needs patience, a little guidance and a whole lot of love to build up his confidence and trust in his surroundings. He's favourite daily activities include; whole body hugs & head kisses, big belly rubs, tearing up a cardboard box then passing out asleep! Bossy is a gentle, sensitive soul who is looking for a calm and understanding home where he can feel safe and supported. He’s a shy boy who will take some time to build confidence, but with patience and consistency, his sweet nature will begin to shine through. While Bossy hasn’t lived inside full-time, he does have some experience being indoors and is already showing great house manners. He’s house trained and walks beautifully on lead, making him a lovely companion for someone after a quiet, easygoing dog. His chill, couch potato vibes mean he’s happiest in a relaxed environment and could potentially suit apartment living if it’s peaceful and predictable. Bossy has shown little interest in our resident cat, so he may be cat and small dog workable with slow and gentle introductions. He also seems comfortable being left alone for periods, which makes him quite adaptable once settled. With a soft bed, gentle guidance, and time to adjust, Bossy will make a calm and loyal addition to the right home.

NAME: Elly
TEXT: Elly is a bright, energetic greyhound with a big, happy personality that’s guaranteed to make you smile every day. She’s best suited to a home with an active lifestyle, where she can enjoy regular walks, plenty of enrichment, and space to unleash her pretty impressive zoomies. She currently lives with whippets and enjoys their company, so she'd likely benefit from having another doggo friend to play and relax with. Elly is small dog workable with slow and respectful introductions, and she’s learning her manners — she’s food motivated and already understands “no,” which makes her a great candidate for continued positive training. Despite her bursts of energy, Elly also knows how to switch off and chill out with her people. She’s affectionate, fun-loving, and full of character - the kind of dog who brings joy and laughter into every day.

NAME: Benji
TEXT: Benji is a sweet and easygoing greyhound who would be the perfect match for someone with a semi-active lifestyle. He enjoys his walks and a good zoom around the yard, but he’s just as happy to curl up on the couch for a cuddle. More of a homebody at heart, Benji is a real people dog who thrives on companionship and being part of the household. He’s a big fan of toys and loves a play session, especially if it’s followed by some quality nap time. Benji walks well on lead and is great with kids, making him a lovely addition to a family environment. He currently lives happily with little whippets and may benefit from having another dog for company. With small dogs and cats, slow and careful introductions will be important, but he shows potential to adjust. A home with a backyard is a must for Benji so he can enjoy his zoomies and outdoor time. Overall, he’s a gentle, affectionate boy who just wants to be close to his people and enjoy the simple pleasures of life.

NAME: Bob
TEXT: Bob is a vibrant and playful greyhound who’s full of life and always ready for the next adventure. He would thrive in an active home with a yard to run around in and older kids to keep him company. Bob is high on life, he loves his zoomies, enjoys playing with toys (his absolute favourite activity), and is always up for a cuddle once he’s had his fun. He walks well on lead and is very social, enjoying the company of people and other dogs. While he’s not a fan of cats, he might do well with a medium to small dog in the home, provided introductions are done slowly and with care. Bob travels beautifully in the car and takes everything in stride. He will need an experienced owner or someone patient and understanding, as he may take a little time to learn house manners and settle into a routine. He’s smart, enthusiastic, and eager to please, he just needs the right guidance. Overall, Bob is just happy to be here. With the right family, he’s going to be an incredibly fun and loving companion.

NAME: Camo
TEXT: Camo is a sweet and gentle greyhound looking for a semi-quiet life with a family who can give him the balance of fun and relaxation he enjoys. He’s the kind of dog who’s happy with a walk, a good zoomie session, and then settling in for some cuddle time on the couch. He walks well on lead and enjoys getting out and about, but he’s not overly high energy. At home, he’s currently living with a Jack Russell and gets along well, so he should be fine with small dogs. He may benefit from having another dog in the home as a companion, but he could also settle as a solo dog with the right people around him. Camo is fine with kids and would be a lovely addition to a family. However, he is not cat workable, so a feline-free home is essential. Overall, Camo is a calm, affectionate boy who just wants a warm spot, some love, and a bit of fun in his day.

NAME: Larry
TEXT: Larry is a beautifully nature boy who would make a great addition to any family. Larry is experienced around kids as young as 1 year old and is soft and gentle around them. Larry enjoys a play around the backyard and is fine with being left alone during the day whilst you work. Larry is crate trained overnight and settles into new environments seamlessly

NAME: Gary
TEXT: Hey mate, the names Gary, good to meet ya! I am a lovely, happy boy, and pretty much a friend to everyone I've met. Everyone loves Gary, if I do say so myself! I'll wag my tail like crazy, probably do a zoomie, but I don't mind my down time too mate! I reckon I could get along with your dog if you've already got one at home, and even those little trouble makers at home, I figure kids would be great fun, more attention for ol' Gary! Give me a backyard or a townhouse and I'll make myself right at home. I might not have been a pet before but I have such a can do attitude, I'll fit in anywhere. Come meet Gaz at Western Sydney.

NAME: José
TEXT: Hi! I have just met you and I love you! I'm José, a friendly, confident boy, I love people, pats and attention! I hope you can see how full of love I am from my cute photos. I will put my head on you and ask for more pats! I'm a sweet guy who is good around other dogs, including mingling with small dogs at times. I don't mind chilling out in a crate but I don't need one! I'd love a backyard, a social life, adventures, and maybe even children to give me lots of pats and adoration, too! Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Pat
TEXT: Hi, I'm Pat! I promise to be the bestest boy ever! I hope you like me too. I am a very friendly and affectionate boy. I love food and can be a little shy. I am called a lounge lizard by my current family. I've even done things like go to the beach, meet children, and see the sights on street walks. I don't really show much interest in toys but I have perfected the greyhound zoomie. A paddock gallop is my 'happy place'. I hope you have a backyard for me to chill out in! You can meet me and "Pat me" at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Xena
TEXT: Xena is a cheeky, gentle and fun little girl. She likes food, and engages nicely with new people once she warms up from being intially a bit shy. Xena lives with another greyhound at the moment so we think she'd do well in a multi-dog household. Older kids would enjoy her gentle yet curious and playful side. Xena has also done things like street walks, hanging out with children, and other socialisation, making her a great companion for families. Her family say nothing phases her! Xena is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Zac (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Zac is a lovely, friendly and confident boy. He has learnt lots about pet life prior to meeting you, including what crates are, the beach, swimming, hangoug out with children, social greetings with visitors to the house, and is very affectionate with people. Zac would be a great addition to a multi-dog household as he currently lives with another greyhound in a house setting. He's described as quiet and laid back, likes his treats and is gentle overall. Zac is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Roy
TEXT: Meet Roy 🐾💛 Roy is a calm, sweet-natured boy who embodies peace, patience, and quiet joy. This handsome boy is happiest when he’s out and about with his doggy friends, peacefully roaming the yard or going on gentle adventures side by side. Roy gets along beautifully with dogs of all sizes—from fellow greyhounds to the tiniest of pups—always showing kindness, curiosity, and a calm, friendly approach. He would absolutely love a home with a backyard where he can stretch his legs, sniff around, and enjoy the fresh air at his own pace. Roy isn't the kind of dog who needs constant activity—he’s more of a gentle wanderer who enjoys his freedom to explore, lounge, and take in the world around him. Roy’s love for humans is just as strong. He’s wonderful with children and has a peaceful, patient demeanour that makes him a safe and loving companion for families. He’s the kind of dog who fits right into the flow of family life—happy to be around people, share quiet time, or simply nap nearby while you go about your day. If you’re looking for a gentle soul to bring peace, love, and quiet joy into your life, Roy is more than ready to become your loyal companion.

NAME: Duffy
TEXT: Meet Duffy 🐾💙 Duffy is a happy-go-lucky male with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging. This friendly boy has a special knack for making friends wherever he goes—he absolutely adores other dogs, whether they’re fellow greyhounds or smaller pups. Duffy especially enjoys the company of female greyhounds and would be thrilled to share his new home with a canine companion to play and relax with. But Duffy’s friendliness doesn’t stop with dogs—he’s also wonderful with children, always eager to say hello and share a joyful moment with little ones. His gentle, playful nature makes him a fantastic family dog, and he thrives in environments where there’s plenty of love and laughter. Duffy is happiest when he has space to run and explore, so a home with a backyard would be the perfect place for him to stretch his legs and soak up the sun. When it’s time for a walk, Duffy shines—he walks beautifully on the lead, making every stroll a peaceful and enjoyable adventure for both him and his humans. Despite his playful spirit, Duffy is a calm and easy-going companion who just wants to bring happiness and affection to his new family. He’s a true social butterfly who loves being part of the action, whether it’s a fun play session with his furry friends, a gentle cuddle on the couch, or a sunny afternoon in the yard.

NAME: Zsa Zsa
TEXT: Introducing Zsa Zsa! Zsa Zsa is a quiet, sweet and playful girl. She is looking for a calm and quiet home, either an apartment or house. Her best suited family would be one without children, so she can enjoy the calm serenity of your home while she grows in confidence. She's a lover of treats and food and has grown in confidence here at the centre. She responds best to gentle encouragement, would be happy to live along side another calm and nurturing/older greyhound or Medium-Large doggie pal. She is confident with our training staircase and would suit shorter hours alone while she settles into her new life. She also settles in a crate, however not required. If you have a quiet home and neighbourhood and are looking for a gentle natured canine companion, Zsa-Zsa could be your perfect fit. She can be adopted from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Meet Lukey 🐾✨ Lukey is a friendly and affectionate male greyhound who’s already experienced the best of both worlds. Having lived inside a loving home, he’s well-socialized with other animals and absolutely adores people of all kinds. Lukey is a confident, happy boy who loves being out and about in the community—whether it’s a walk in the park, a visit to a café, or simply exploring new places, he takes it all in with a wagging tail and bright eyes. This easy-going guy thrives on affection and will happily shower you with love in return. Lukey’s calm and gentle nature makes him a fantastic companion, ready to settle into family life or enjoy the company of other pets. His experience living indoors means he’s well-behaved and adaptable, making him a smooth fit into homes big or small. If you’re looking for a loving, sociable, and happy-hearted greyhound who’s ready to be your loyal sidekick, Lukey is the perfect match. He’s excited to share his affectionate nature and joyful spirit with a forever family.

NAME: Royal
TEXT: Meet Royal 👑🐾 Royal is a delightful girl who truly lives up to her name. She’s a playful and affectionate sweetheart who adores making friends—especially with other dogs, no matter their size! Royal’s favourite thing in the world is playing with her furry pals, and she’ll happily invite any dog she meets to join in on the fun. Whether it’s a game of chase, tug, or just a joyful romp, Royal is always ready to play. This gentle lady would make a wonderful family pet. She’s calm and confident, not easily stressed by new people or environments, which makes her adaptable and easygoing in all kinds of settings. Royal loves her toys and can spend hours happily entertaining herself or sharing playtime with her favourite humans. When she’s not busy playing or making new friends, Royal is a cuddle bug who loves to snuggle up and soak in all the love and attention she can get. She’s a perfect balance of lively and laid-back—a true joy to have around. If you’re looking for a loving, playful, and incredibly social companion who will bring laughter and warmth into your home, Royal is ready to steal your heart and become your family’s new best friend.

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Meet Tiger 🐾 Tiger is a confident and charismatic boy with a heart as big as his smile. This energetic bundle of joy is a true social butterfly who thrives on friendship—whether it’s with dogs big or small, Tiger’s easy-going nature and playful attitude make him a favourite in any multi-pet household. But don’t worry, he’s just as happy being the one and only furry family member, soaking up all the love and attention you can give. Tiger is the perfect blend of playful goofiness and calm confidence. He’s always ready to brighten your day with his silly antics, goofy grin, and endless tail wags. Despite his lively energy, he knows how to relax and enjoy quiet cuddle time, making him a well-rounded companion. What really sets Tiger apart is his gentle and loving spirit. He’s great with children, understanding and patient, making him an ideal family dog. Whether it’s playing games in the yard or snuggling up for story time, Tiger is sure to be a beloved member of your home. If you’re looking for a loyal, happy, and affectionate friend who will keep you smiling and fill your days with love, Tiger is the perfect match. He’s confident, outgoing, and ready to bring joy to a home that appreciates a lively, loving, and goofy boy with a heart full of love. Could Tiger be the one to steal your heart?

NAME: T Rex
TEXT: Meet T-Rex 🦕 Dog Friendly: Yes – best with medium to large dogs Child Friendly: Yes – best suited to a home with older children Ideal Home: A family with a secure backyard and an active lifestyle Don’t let the name fool you – T-Rex is all heart and happiness! This big, bouncy boy is bursting with personality and ready to find a family who’ll love his enthusiastic, affectionate nature. T-Rex is a social butterfly through and through. He’s currently living with other greyhounds and thrives in their company, especially those who can match his playful energy. He’s also friendly with medium and large dogs, and loves being part of a pack. This boy lives for his people – always close by, always ready to join in. Whether you're moving around the house or heading out for an adventure, expect T-Rex to be your loyal shadow. He’s interactive, affectionate, and happiest when included. T-Rex would do best in a home with older children who can enjoy his energy and help guide his big personality. A backyard is a must – he’s got some serious zoomie skills and needs space to stretch those long legs. While he’s eager to get out and explore, T-Rex can be strong on the lead, so he’ll need confident handlers who can continue his training and help him channel his excitement on walks. He will be your super social and loyal shadow and sidekick If you’re ready for a fun, affectionate, and outgoing greyhound who will bring non-stop joy and energy into your life, T-Rex is your guy.

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red ❤️ Say hello to Red – a tender-hearted boy with a sweet soul and the most soulful eyes you’ve ever seen. Red may be a little reserved at first, but once he feels safe and settled, he shows his loving personality in the most heartwarming ways. Red is great with other greyhounds and enjoys their calm, familiar company. He’s also been around smaller dogs – he just may need a slower, thoughtful introduction to build his comfort and confidence. With the right introductions and guidance, he’s more than happy to share his space with gentle doggy friends. Red has been around children in a home environment and handles it well with his naturally gentle nature. However, due to his shy disposition, a quieter home – perhaps with older, dog-savvy kids – would be the best match for him. He thrives in calm, predictable spaces where he can truly feel at ease. Red can be a bit nervous when meeting new people or exploring new situations, but give him time and patience, and you’ll be rewarded with the trust and love of a truly special dog. He prefers to interact on his own terms – not pushy or demanding, just quietly curious and kind. Red enjoys his peaceful moments, lounging nearby, quietly observing, and choosing when to come over for a little affection or company. His independence, mixed with his loving nature, makes him a calm and comforting presence in the home. Red would thrive in a gentle, patient home where he can settle in at his own pace and build trust with his new family. He doesn’t ask for much – just kindness, understanding, and a safe space where he can be himself. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion with the sweetest heart.

NAME: Finn
TEXT: Meet Finn 🌸 Introducing Finn – a quiet sweetheart with a gentle heart and a peaceful presence. This lovely girl may be a little shy when you first meet her, but once she feels safe, her soft personality begins to shine through 💕🐾 Finn is wonderfully social with other dogs – big or small. She’s respectful, calm, and happy to let others take the spotlight, making her an ideal companion for a household with other canine friends after a slow introduction. 🐕🐾 Finn has lived with children before and is gentle and patient with little ones. While she tends to keep to herself, she’s more than happy to be part of a loving family. She would do best in a home where kids understand that she might need a bit of time and space to settle in. Finn might take a little time to come out of her shell, but once she feels at ease, she’ll quietly sneak her way into your heart. She doesn’t demand attention but loves being near her people, soaking up the calm and comfort of a loving home. She’s the kind of dog who’s happy to do her own thing – whether it’s napping in a cozy spot or quietly observing from a distance. But don’t be surprised if she comes over for a gentle nuzzle or a loving glance – Finn gives affection in her own soft, sweet way. 🥰

NAME: Selwin
TEXT: Meet Selwin 🖤 Say hello to Selwin, a gorgeous boy with a soft heart, curious mind, and a lifetime of love to give. Selwin may take a little time to warm up, but once he trusts you, you’ll have a loyal and affectionate companion by your side. Selwin has grown up around children and knows how to be calm and gentle in their presence. He’s also well-socialised with other dogs, getting along beautifully with medium and large breeds—including other greyhounds and even a German Shepherd buddy! He’d love a home where he can share space with canine companions or be your one-and-only shadow. This sweet boy has a thoughtful, inquisitive nature. He enjoys taking in the world at his own pace and has proven to be unfazed by nearby farm animals like sheep and horses—nothing much rattles Selwin's cool composure. What would make Selwin happiest? A quiet home with a backyard or courtyard where he can potter around, stretch his legs, and soak up the sun between naps. While he doesn’t need a lot of exercise, he appreciates the freedom to explore a safe outdoor space. His independent and relaxed personality also makes him well-suited for full-time workers—he’s perfectly happy doing his own thing while you’re away, then greeting you with a wag and a nuzzle when you return. If you’re looking for a gentle, low-maintenance companion with a big heart and a quiet charm, Selwin might just be the boy for you. With a bit of patience and a lot of love, he’ll blossom into your most devoted friend. 👇 Click here for information on the ANU adoption day & to register for the dogalogue

NAME: Vaughn
TEXT: Vaughn has been described by his handlers as simply "amazing"! He is outgoing and affectionate with people & would suit a family home with a yard for him to relax in. He cannot wait to show you his Vaughn-derful personality! He is highly engaged with his training, best suited to house/townhouse living and settles alone well in a backyard setting. He’s already learned a bunch of tricks like 'down', shake, recall, his name, and on/off bed, and he’s currently working on sit. He’s quick to pick things up! He will need a home with a yard where he can run and play till his heart’s content. A family that will continue to help him on his training journey and a calm, loving environment where he can relax and feel secure. His best home is a family who want to do dog training, adventures and cool fun activities with him! Vaughn is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Bub
TEXT: Meet Bub! Say hello to Bub, a sweet-natured older girl who’s ready to enjoy the simple pleasures of retirement. Bub is looking for a quiet, peaceful home where she can soak up the sun, enjoy some gentle pats, and claim a soft, cosy bed as her own. With her graceful charm and soft eyes, Bub has a spring in her step, but she’s very low-maintenance when it comes to exercise – a short burst of energy in the yard, a few short strolls and a bit of backyard sunbathing are all she needs to be content. She would thrive as an only dog, but she’s also happy to share her space with a male greyhound companion. Bub is a great match for full-time workers if there’s a secure backyard where she can relax during the day. She would also suit a calm household with older children who respect her quiet nature. If you're after a gentle soul who’s past the puppy chaos and just wants to be your loyal companion, Bub might just be the girl you’ve been waiting for. ☀️ Loves: Sunbaking, soft beds, peaceful vibes 🏡 Best home: Quiet environment, backyard, solo or with a male greyhound 💙 Personality: Calm, sweet, gentle, quietly affectionate 🦴 Exercise needs: Minimal – a yard for a quick zoom, a gentle stroll, she’s more nap than zoom Let Bub bring serenity, love, and a little sparkle into your life.

NAME: Zippa
TEXT: Meet Zippa!🐾 Zippa is a charming, affectionate boy who’s never met a dog he didn’t want to be friends with—especially if they’re fellow greyhounds! He thrives on canine company and is always the first to say hello with a happy wag and a gentle nuzzle. This social superstar settles quickly into new environments and brings calm confidence wherever he goes. Whether it’s a bustling park or a cozy home, Zippa makes himself right at home in no time. He absolutely adores human affection and will happily lean in for cuddles, neck scritches, and all the love you’re willing to give. With his friendly nature and easy-going personality, Zippa is a joy to have around and will make a wonderful companion for a home with other dogs—or just humans ready to shower him with love.

NAME: Jazz
TEXT: Meet Jazz! 🎷 Jazz is a laid-back, friendly girl with a lovely nature and a true love for canine company. She currently lives with other dogs and absolutely adores them—playtime with her four-legged friends is one of her favourite things in the world! While she’s polite and relaxed around new people, Jazz is definitely more of a “dogs before humans” kind of girl, always happiest when she’s part of a playful pack. This cool and easy-going girl travels like a pro and is perfectly at ease in the car, making her a great companion for road trips, day outings, or simply tagging along for the ride. Jazz takes everything in stride and brings a calm, contented energy wherever she goes. With her sweet, social nature and gentle personality, Jazz would thrive in a home with other dogs and a relaxed routine. If you're looking for a happy, well-adjusted boy who loves her canine companions and brings a quiet charm to every room, Jazz might just be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Rose
TEXT: Meet Rose!🌹 Rose is as lovely as her name suggests — a sweet, affectionate, and joyful greyhound who’s ready to fill her forever home with love, laughter, and plenty of cuddles. This social butterfly gets along beautifully with other dogs and is wonderful with children, making her a perfect match for a family home or anyone looking for a friendly companion to share life’s adventures. Rose loves her humans and thrives on affection — she’s happiest when she’s being cuddled, fussed over, or showered in kisses (which she’ll gladly return!). With her super affectionate nature and calm, gentle spirit, Rose has earned the title of “big cuddle monster” from everyone who’s met her. Whether she’s curled up next to you on the couch, leaning in for pats, or simply following you from room to room, she’ll always find a way to be close and connected. Rose is a confident, happy girl who’s ready to take on the world with her new family by her side. If you're looking for a loving, loyal, and snuggly companion who will be your shadow and your biggest fan, Rose is ready to blossom in her forever home.

NAME: Pebbles
TEXT: Meet Pebbles! 🐶 Pebbles is a bright, bubbly, and super social greyhound who’s ready to win hearts wherever she goes! This lovely lady has a big personality and an even bigger heart — she adores the company of other dogs and gets along with absolutely everyone she meets, both two-legged and four. Pebbles has been well-socialised in the community and is comfortable and confident in a variety of environments. She’s spent plenty of time indoors and knows how to settle into home life with ease. Whether she's out and about or relaxing at home, Pebbles is always engaged, curious, and tuned into her humans. She’s a huge fan of pats, cuddles, and—of course—treats! Show her a snack and she’ll be your best friend in an instant. Her friendly, affectionate nature makes her a joy to be around, and she’s always up for a chat (or at least a tail wag and a nuzzle). Pebbles would thrive in a home where she can continue being part of the action—whether it’s social outings, doggy playdates, or simply lounging at your feet after a day full of love and attention. If you're looking for a sweet, sociable girl who’s already got the hang of home life and is ready to be your loyal companion, Pebbles is your perfect match.

NAME: Laverne
TEXT: Meet Laverne! 🌸 Laverne is a sweet and sociable greyhound who’s ready to charm her way into your heart — and your home! This lovely girl gets along beautifully with other dogs, especially fellow greyhounds, and would make a wonderful addition to a home with canine companions. Laverne has been exposed to life both indoors and out, and she handles it all like a pro. She’s comfortable walking through busy streets and settles quickly once back inside, making her a great fit for suburban or city living. She's already shown she knows how to make herself at home — whether it’s lounging on a comfy bed or quietly hanging out with her humans. Always up for affection, Laverne will happily trot over for pats, cuddles, and a bit of love. Her gentle, friendly nature makes her easy to fall for, and she thrives on human connection without being overly demanding. With her easy-going temperament and affectionate heart, Laverne is ready to become a loyal and loving house pet. If you’re looking for a sweet companion who’s as calm as she is cuddly, Laverne could be your perfect match.

NAME: Magpie
TEXT: Magpie is a very charming and affectionate boy, he is great with other greyhounds and has lived around a Labrador in semi rural environment. Has been walked by kids regularly.

NAME: Ivy
TEXT: Ivy is a beautiful girl who loves to play, like most greyhounds she loves a morning zoomie and a bit of fun followed by some serious relaxing and lounging around. She is sweet social and confident girl.

NAME: Bert
TEXT: Bert is a shy boy who is growing more confidence every day. He is adorable, endearing, tiny in size, and has these bright brown eyes... He most importantly has a one of a kind, amazing personality which one lucky family will get to see! He has tested politely around all animals at the centre including small dogs and cats. He has a wiggly goofy side and we all love him at the centre as we've seen him transform and grow in confidence. Once he knows you he is super affectionate and friendly & even has an excitable and playful side that is coming out more and more. What has helped him grow in confidence is his love of food and treats, and other dogs his size. He gets a lot of social support and confidence from other greyhounds. We think an experienced greyhound owner, a quiet nurturing home, and a backyard/townhouse will set Bert up for success. Teenage kids who have experience with shy dogs would be suitable. We are looking for a perfect fit for our Bert and we are hoping you love him too! This goofy, quirky, adorable little guy is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bobby (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Bobby is a lovely, quiet and friendly boy who has experience with kids 6-10 yrs old. He's been learning about the family household and has spent time mingling with other breeds including German Shepherds, and would suit a home with a Medium-Large dog friend. He likes playing with kids, fine meeting new people and strangers, and has a confident, adaptable nature about him. Did we mention he has adorable floppy ears, too? Meet Bobby at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Nacho
TEXT: Taco bout cute! We don't want to make it too cheesy, but in between napping and playtime, we think Nacho's got what it takes to salsa into your life like he's always been there. Nacho would be a great accompaniment to a home with another small, medium or large dog! He is affectionate, friendly and confident. Respectful with dog experience would be a great match. He’s looking for a family who can appreciate a dog with a zest for life (and cheesy puns...) Nacho is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre. All you have to do is bring the love (and maybe some chips).

NAME: Yori
TEXT: Meet Yori 🐾💙 If you’re after a cheerful, people-loving, tail-wagging goofball of a greyhound... look no further than Yori! This happy boy is bursting with personality and charm – the kind of dog who lights up every room (and park, and café, and office!) he walks into. Yori is an all-around social butterfly. He absolutely loves people and wants to say hello to everyone he meets – humans, dogs, kids, you name it. He’ll trot over with his big happy grin, lean in for pats, and soak up every bit of love like the big softie he is. He’s also a classic Velcro hound – always ready to follow you from room to room like your biggest fan (which, let’s be honest, he is). Whether you're cooking dinner, working from home, or binge-watching your favourite show, Yori will be right there, just happy to be near you. ✅ Great with other dogs ✅ Wonderful with children ✅ Equally happy solo or with a greyhound friend ✅ Loves cuddles, pats, and being part of the action ✅ Would make the perfect office dog (he’d love to go to work with you!) Despite his goofy, happy-go-lucky nature, Yori is easy-going and well-mannered. He doesn’t ask for much – just your company, a few good belly rubs, and the chance to be your loyal sidekick. Yori is ready to be your best mate – at home, at work, and everywhere in between. He’s got love to give, a wag for everyone, and a heart as big as his smile. *Come meet Yori at the Binalong Community Market Day on Sunday 9th November, 10am- 1pm.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Meet Cindy! 🐾 Say hello to Cindy, a beautifully relaxed and loving girl who's ready to bring warmth and joy into a forever home. With her gentle soul and easy-going nature, Cindy is one of those special dogs who fits in just about anywhere. She’s brilliantly behaved, loves the company of other dogs, and is wonderfully gentle with children – making her a perfect addition to families, couples, or anyone simply looking for a calm and affectionate companion. Cindy’s biggest joy in life is being with her people. Whether she’s nuzzling in for kisses, leaning in for cuddles, or gently pawing for another pat, she’ll melt your heart in an instant. She’s also playful in the most delightful way – happy to toss around a toy in the backyard before stretching out in the sun for a lazy afternoon snooze. Cindy doesn’t ask for much – just love, comfort, and a family to share her sweetheart with. If you're looking for a calm, cuddly, sunshine-loving greyhound who will adore you endlessly, Cindy is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Double
TEXT: Meet Double! 🐾 Looking for a fun, friendly, go-anywhere kind of dog? Double might just be your perfect match! This gorgeous boy is as adaptable as they come – he’d thrive in just about any environment, whether it’s a busy family home or a quieter setting with active humans. Double walks beautifully on the lead, gets along wonderfully with all dogs, and adores children of all ages. He loves his people and to be involved with everything going on inside your household. With his playful, engaging personality, Double is always up for some fun – especially if it involves toys or exploring new places. He’d love a family that enjoys adventures and will include him in their day-to-day life, from park strolls to weekend outings. Double is more than ready to bring joy, fun, and a whole lot of love into his forever home!

NAME: Stripes
TEXT: Meet Stripes! 🐾 Say hello to Stripes, a handsome boy with a heart as big as his personality! This sweet-natured greyhound is an all-around superstar – he absolutely adores other dogs and is wonderfully gentle with children, making him the perfect companion for families of all kinds. Stripes is a model kennel dog – clean, calm, and relaxed in his space. Out and about, he walks beautifully on the lead, enjoying every stroll with curiosity and grace. With his outgoing and affectionate personality, Stripes loves meeting new people and making friends wherever he goes. If you’re looking for a friendly, sociable, and easy-going greyhound who fits in just about anywhere, Stripes is your guy!

NAME: Lulu
TEXT: *Lulu is in a foster care home in an apartment - reach out to the team to meet her!* Lulu has great leash manners, enjoys spending time indoors, happy for some hours alone (even likes a crate!), and did we mention she can "sit"? Lulu shows lots of training potential as a few treats are the way to this girls heart. Lulu loves to give affection just as much as she loves to give it and cant wait to find her new family. Her new family might even already have a another dog, which Lulu wouldn't mind! She is apartment suitable, suitable for children and is very affectionate and trainable. Are you ready for lovely Lulu to become apart of your family? Meet her at Western Sydney 😄

NAME: Son
TEXT: Hi, I'm Son! I've been described as calm, loving, sociable, and easy going! I'm happy travelling, snoozing in crates, snuggling into new people for a bit of attention and pats. I've got a charming nature and I think I'm pretty adaptable in new situations! I would suit respectful kids and a backyard to search for my toys in! I'm a confident fella who can't wait to meet you. You can meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jay
TEXT: Hello, aren't I handsome? My name is Jay and I can't wait to meet you... A little bit about me. I've been around kids 3 and up, and even spent some time hanging out with a sausage dog which I thought was pretty fun! My ideal home? Well I'd like a townhouse or backyard, gotta show off my zoomies and snooze in the sun of course. I can be a bit shy so I hope you have the patience to see me grow into a confident boy along side you. I really like a gentle touch and an understanding person to make me feel comfortable. Please come and see me at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Edi
TEXT: Hi, I'm Edi! I was born on Christmas Day! I can be shy around new people but I promise to be a total love bug once I know you! I'm learning about all things "pet" right now including being indoors, things like couches and TV's are pretty cool! I also like the crate, and the splashy pool in summer! I'm learning about busy streets and have mingled with kids, too. I am quiet, affectionate, calm and friendly and hope you would like to come and meet me at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: China
TEXT: Watch out for those big puppy dog eyes! Sweet little China is as precious as his porcelain name! China is a fun, sometimes shy, sometimes playful, sweet boy looking for a home! China is polite with big and small dogs on walkies and would be happy to share his new world with a dog by his side. He walks nicely on lead and has your quintessential greyhound personality of zoomies, naps and will always greet you with a little wagging tail. Respectful children are welcome, too. We can't wait to see who loves China as much as we do! China can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Dennis
TEXT: Dennis is a polite and confident middle aged gentleman who is happy to receive pats and attention from any of his admirers! Dennis would suit a home with respectful children who are looking for an affectionate play mate. Dennis walks nicely on the lead and loves to catch up on all the sniffs around town while showing off his good looks. Dennis is a lovely gentleman who will thrive with a townhouse/backyard and or doggie friends to keep him company! Dennis can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Diesel
TEXT: With his sweet little undershot jaw, Diesel oozes character both on the outside and on the inside! This sweet dog is good with children and other dogs, he is ready to slot right into family life and find a sofa to call his own. Whist he loves to play ball and goof around, Diesel is also happy to curl up next to his person for a cuddle and a snooze!

NAME: Yukey
TEXT: Meet Yuckey! 🐶💖 Yuckey is a sweet and playful girl with a heart full of love and a special bond with her best friend, Rufus. These two are inseparable! Yuckey walks beautifully on the lead and enjoys playtime with her toys and doggy friends. She’s equally happy to chill out and watch the world go by, making her a wonderful balance of fun and calm. If you're ready to open your home to a girl full of love, personality, and charm, Yuckey is ready to meet you!

NAME: Rufus
TEXT: Introducing Rufus! 🐾❤️ Rufus is a gentle, social boy who absolutely adores his canine companions — especially his best mate, Yukey! He really comes to life when he is around other greyhounds. Rufus is calm, affectionate, and walks beautifully on the lead, making him a joy to take on daily strolls. He could also live with a cat, given a slow introduction. If you're looking to welcome not just one, but two sweet, well-mannered greyhounds into your heart and home, Rufus and Yukey might be the perfect duo for you!

NAME: Sahsa
TEXT: Meet Sasha! 🐶 Sasha is a sweet and social greyhound who absolutely loves the company of other dogs! She currently lives happily with another canine companion and would thrive in a home with a doggy friend. Sasha is also a great traveller — she settles beautifully in the car, making her a perfect road trip buddy. Treats and toys are two of Sasha's favourite things, and her playful personality shines when she's having fun. While she adores other dogs, she’ll need a slow and thoughtful introduction to smaller pups to help her feel settled. If you’re looking for a loving, playful girl who’s ready to be part of the pack, Sasha could be your perfect match!

NAME: Longy
TEXT: Meet Longy! 🐶🌟 Longy is a bright, bubbly boy bursting with personality and charm! He’s a true social butterfly who adores both human and canine company, making friends wherever he goes. Longy is especially good with children and dogs of all sizes, though he’ll need a slow and gentle introduction to the littlest ones. This zoomie king loves to stretch his legs and would really thrive in a home with a backyard where he can let loose and have some fun. Whether he's playing, cuddling, or just soaking up the love, Longy brings joy to every moment. If you're after a fun, friendly, and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to be part of an active and loving home, Longy could be the perfect addition to your family!

NAME: Mow
TEXT: Meet Mow! 💖 Mow is a joyful, playful greyhound with a zest for life and a heart full of happiness! She’s a social girl who gets along wonderfully with medium to large dogs and would be more than happy to have a canine companion to share her days with. This toy-loving sweetheart is always up for a game or a bit of fun, and her cheerful personality is sure to brighten any home. Mow would be a perfect fit for an active household where she can join in on adventures, enjoy regular playtime, and be part of the family action. If you're looking for a fun, loving, and outgoing greyhound to be your next best friend, Mow is ready to meet you!

NAME: Boris
TEXT: Meet Boris! 🐕 Boris is a high-energy, fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. With his confident nature and bouncy enthusiasm, he’s always ready to play, explore, and soak up all the affection he can get. Boris gets along great with medium to large dogs and would thrive in an active home where he can be part of the action. Whether it’s going on adventures, playing in the yard, or just enjoying time with his people, Boris is all in. He would also love a friend at home to keep him company and is happy to play with him. If you’re an energetic family looking for a lively, loving companion who brings joy wherever he goes, Boris is your guy!

NAME: Jimothy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jimothy. I'm a quiet and gentle boy who is nice on the lead. I can be a bit nervous around new people and new places but I am so eager to please. I can do a cute "sit" which took everyone by surprise! I love a gentle touch and reassurance, and would enjoy a home with another dog to build my confidence. Overall I can be summed up as gentle and charming and I hope you want to meet me, too! I can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Puds
TEXT: Meet Puds! 🐾 Puds is a handsome greyhound with a heart as big as his zoomies! This laid-back boy loves nothing more than chilling out with other greyhounds and medium-to-large canine companions. He’s happy to kick back and relax but also has a playful side – especially when toys are involved! Puds is food-motivated and eager to please, making training a breeze. He’d thrive in an active home where he can join in on daily walks or adventures, then unwind with his humans. A backyard would be a bonus for this boy, giving him space to stretch his legs and let loose when the zoomie urge strikes. If you're looking for a loving, social, and fun companion with just the right mix of chill and energy, Puds could be your perfect match!

NAME: Gazza
TEXT: Gazza is a sweet boy who travels well in vans, cars and trailer, also walks well on lead on adventures out and about. Gazza has shown polite manners with children ranging from 20 months to 9 years old, showing a gentle & polite indifference. Gazza has spent time mingling with big and small dogs and would suit a home looking for a laid back boy happy to go with the flow. Gazza dreams of a little backyard to spend his days in and kids to keep him entertained during the day. He can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Ocean
TEXT: Don't let my greying face fool you, I'm a friendly bubbly guy ready to join your family. Ocean is a curious and confident boy who loves his toys, has learnt his name and will even come when called. This serene boy walks nicely on the lead, too, making him a lovely walking companion. Ocean is a wonderful boy who is ready to bring balance and peace to his new home! Ocean can be adopted at the Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Soy
TEXT: Meet Soy, the joyful boy who is friendly, easy going and great with kids and dogs of all sizes. Soy's happy-go-lucky personality is perfect for anyone looking to bring energy and fun into their home. He would be happy to share his new life with other dogs big or small. Whether he's catching a ball or simply lounging by your side, Soy revels in the company of his human friends, showcasing his loyalty and affection in delightful ways. Soy can be adopted at Western Sydney!

NAME: Kenneth
TEXT: Kenneth loves playing with other dogs and would do well with a family who enjoy big playful dogs. Kenneth would suit full time workers as he has shown he is happy to settle alone. Being middle aged, he's ready to take it easy and enjoy the retirement life but does have that fun streak! Kenneth is super food focused, learning all sorts of tricks while he waits for his forever home here at the centre. This includes the 'focus' cue, recall/come, touch and more. He's a friendly and affectionate boy who is suitable to live with respectful children or another M-L doggie pal providing they're a match for his bouncy play style with other dogs. He has the sweetest little face with an adorable personality to match. Come meet Kenneth at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Toby
TEXT: Toby is a confident and cheerful boy who is happy wherever he goes! If you're looking for a charming, affectionate and happy go lucky boy, Toby could be perfect for you. Toby would love a townhouse or backyard to practise his zoomies. We can see Toby fitting well into a household with polite children due to his lovable ways! Meet Toby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Jumbo
TEXT: Hi, I'm Jumbo! I'm a very handsome boy, looking for a place to call home. I love all of my human friends and I like to show off my confidence meeting new people when I'm out and about. I love going on outdoor adventures and I enjoy my daily walks too...oh and did I mention I'm a stair master? I wouldn't mind two story home or a place that needs to be go up and down a few stairs. I could potentionally go home with another medium to large breed sibling, pending a meet and greet. I also loooove treats and have been responding very well to my training. Could I be the guy you're looking for? Come and meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack 🐾🌿 Jack is a confident, relaxed boy who takes everything in his stride. Whether it’s a new place, a new walk, or a new friend, Jack approaches life with a calm curiosity and a steady tail wag. He settles quickly into new environments, walks beautifully on the lead, and is a total pro when it comes to travelling. Whether you're heading out for a stroll or a weekend getaway, Jack is more than happy to come along for the ride. Jack’s gentle confidence and easy going nature make him a dream companion for anyone looking for a loyal friend who’s as chill as he is curious. If you're after a greyhound who’s ready to explore the world—but just as happy to lounge by your side—Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Albert
TEXT: Meet Albert 🐾 Albert is a quiet, clean, and gentle soul who’s ready to find his forever home. He’s the kind of greyhound who takes life in his stride—literally! He walks beautifully on the lead, travels like a pro, and is an all-around easy companion. While he can be a little shy at first, Albert warms up quickly and really comes into his own once he’s settled. He absolutely loves a good run with his canine pals and gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes. Albert would thrive in a calm, loving home where he can enjoy his daily walks, zoomies with friends, and a comfy spot to relax. If you're looking for a sweet, well-mannered boy with a playful side, Albert might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Chunk
TEXT: Meet Chunk – The Quiche-Connoisseur 🐶 Chunk is a friendly, easy-going boy with a heart of gold and a nose for snacks! He’s a social boy who loves the company of other dogs and would be more than happy to share his space (and his toys) with a furry friend. Don’t let his name fool you – Chunk is all charm and cheer. He may take a little time to say hello properly, but once he’s settled, he’s all smiles and tail wags. His gentle nature makes him a lovely companion, and he’s always up for a cuddle or a game. Be warned: Chunk is a bit of a food enthusiast. He may sneak a bite of your quiche if you’re not looking – but he promises to do it with love. 😄 If you’re after a laid-back, affectionate pup with a bit of a cheeky side, Chunk might just be your perfect match.

NAME: Thor
TEXT: Thor – Mighty God of thunder and lightning and protector of mankind...this friendly boy from the moment he meets you, he’ll be buttering you up with his big puppy dog eyes asking for a treat. If you have an Avengers team of other hounds at home, we think that Thor wouldn’t mind some crime-fighting canine company, but he’s happy on his own as well for shorter stints of time alone to begin with. He would do best with a small grassed yard with opaque/colour bond fencing in a quiet neighbourhood as he can become overwhelmed with too much going on in the neighbourhood. His gentle and friendly nature would see him fit perfectly into a home with older kids or teens! If Thor (minus the hammer) sounds like the perfect fit for your Asgard, assemble your family, and together you can embark on a heroic journey to meet him at our Western Sydney adoption facility.

NAME: Snippy
TEXT: Snippy is a relaxed, friendly, easy-going gentleman, who’s not jumpy and a dream on the lead. He’s super social, affectionate, and loves spending time with people - he just adores the grandkids aged 6 and up! Snippy’s happy nature makes him an excellent pet - he LOVES to lean on you and get cuddles, which we just love! He’s great with other calm natured greys, and would prefer shorter hours alone as a solo pet. He loves his daily walks, swimming adventures, and is very food-motivated making him a breeze to train. He’d thrive in a home with someone who has time to hang out with him and has a nice quiet backyard for him to chill out in. Snippy has mastered stairs so a home with some steps is A-O-K! This friendly fella is at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Grace
TEXT: Meet Grace ☀️ Grace is a calm, friendly girl with a beautifully chilled personality and a love for the simple things in life — like a sunny spot to nap in and the company of other dogs. She’s previously lived happily with other canine companions and would love a home where she can continue to enjoy that friendship. She would be equally as happy being an only dog with her human friends. Grace has lived inside a home before; she walks nicely on the lead and travels well — making outings easy and enjoyable. Whether she's strolling beside you or stretching out in the sunshine, Grace brings a gentle, contented energy wherever she goes. She’s the perfect mix of affectionate and independent and would thrive in a home that appreciates her relaxed nature and loving heart. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who’s happy to share her space, her sunshine, and her heart — Grace is ready to meet you.

NAME: Edna
TEXT: Meet Edna 🌸 Edna is a lovely, soft-natured girl with a quiet charm and a heart full of potential. She enjoys the company of other dogs and her human friends. Edna walks beautifully on the lead and travels calmly, making her a joy to take out and about. While she may be a little shy at first, given time and gentle encouragement, she begins to show her sweet, affectionate personality. She would thrive in a quieter home where she can take things slowly and build confidence with patient people by her side, especially as she navigates new environments at her own pace. Once she feels settled, Edna blossoms — and her gentle companionship is truly special. If you're looking for a loyal friend to love and nurture, Edna might just be the perfect match.

NAME: Indi
TEXT: Meet Indi! 🐾 Indi is a sweet-natured girl with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging! She adores the company of other dogs and is always excited to make new canine (and human!) friends. With her calm and gentle nature, Indi is the kind of dog who turns heads and wins hearts wherever she goes. She's a fantastic traveller — relaxed and content whether it's a short trip to the park or a longer adventure. Patience is one of her superpowers, and she takes everything in stride with a happy grin and waggy tail. If you're looking for a friendly, sociable companion who's always happy to say hello, Indi is your girl. 💕🐶

NAME: Lewis
TEXT: Meet Lewis 🐶 Lewis is a bright, bouncy bundle of joy with a heart full of love and a tail that never stops wagging! This friendly greyhound is fantastic with other dogs and has previously lived happily with other grey’s. He's a true social butterfly who fits right in with canine company. Great with children and always gentle, Lewis has that perfect mix of playful energy and relaxed charm. His happy-go-lucky nature makes him a joy to have around – whether you’re heading out for a walk or just relaxing at home, he’s always up for whatever’s going on. And yes, treats? Don’t even say the word unless you’re ready to hand one over – Lewis is a treat-loving legend! If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable, all-round good boy, Lewis could be your perfect match.

NAME: Horse
TEXT: Meet Horse 🐾 Horse might have a big name, but he’s a total softie at heart. This gorgeous boy is the definition of laid-back – calm, collected, and always up for a cuddle or a tasty treat (he’s a bit of a snack connoisseur!). Horse gets along brilliantly with other dogs, making him the perfect companion whether you're out on a group walk or welcoming visitors at home. He travels like a pro, whether it's a quick ride or a longer trip, and he's even happy to wait patiently in the car while you pop into the shops – no fuss, no bother.
